answers.text: Allowed if you intend to get ahead of the second car

questions.comment: Outside a populated area, in just such a situation, if there are two lanes in a given direction, you are allowed to stay in the left lane so as not to make unnecessary maneuvers while ahead. At the same time, you must not interfere with vehicles moving behind you at a higher speed (Clause 9.4 of the Traffic Regulations).
topic: Location of vehicles on the roadway

questions.question: Which driver parked the car correctly?
questions.comment: None of the drivers parked the car correctly. The driver of any truck in all cases does not have the right to drive onto the sidewalk adjacent to the roadway. Drivers of passenger cars can do this only in places marked with sign 6.4 “Parking (parking space)” with sign 8.6.2 “Method of parking a vehicle.” (Clause 12.2 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Which driver making a turn will violate the Rules?
questions.comment: Sign 4.1.1 “Move straight” in this case is installed immediately before the intersection of roadways, i.e. before the intersection. You can only continue moving straight ahead. In this situation, both drivers violate the Rules. ("Road Signs")

questions.question: You intend to continue moving in a forward direction. What are your actions?

answers.text: Give way to cars and motorcycles

questions.comment: The intersection is equal. When determining the order in which vehicles travel through an intersection, we are guided by the “right-hand rule,” i.e. Whoever has an obstacle on the right concedes. The peculiarity of solving this issue is to roll out and stop at the intersection of a vehicle starting to move. The driver of the car starts moving first, turning left, since at the initial moment there is no obstacle on the right. Having reached the middle of the intersection, before turning left, he will stop, as he must give way to the motorcyclist on his right. After this, there will be no obstacle on the right on the trajectory of your car - you pass the intersection first. The motorcyclist is after you. And the last one to finish crossing the intersection is the driver who started moving. (Clause 13.11 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Who should you give way to when turning left?
questions.comment: The intersection is unequal. The main road changes direction. Vehicles on the main road have priority. Between themselves, trackless vehicles are guided by the “right-hand rule”, giving way to a tram, which, under equal conditions, has an advantage over them. Tram “Б” passes first, then a passenger car, and you after them. Tram “А” will pass last, since it is located on a secondary road. (Clause 13.9, 13.1, 13.11 Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Stopping on a motorway is permitted:

answers.text: Just to the right of the marking line marking the edge of the roadway
Only in special parking areas marked with appropriate signs

questions.comment: According to clause 16.1 of the traffic rules, stopping on the highway is possible only at special parking areas marked with appropriate signs.

questions.question: What external lighting devices should be used when driving at night on illuminated sections of roads in a populated area?

answers.text: Side lights or low beam headlights

questions.comment: At night, on illuminated sections of roads located in a populated area, when driving, the driver must turn on the low beam headlights. (Clause 19.2 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Use of external lighting fixtures and audible signals

questions.question: In the event of any malfunction, it is forbidden to continue the movement of the vehicle even to the place of repair or parking?

answers.text: The service brake system is faulty

questions.comment: Driving with a faulty service brake system poses a clear danger, so driving is prohibited. (Clause 2.3.1 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Malfunctions and conditions for admitting vehicles to operation

questions.question: A truck is more resistant to rollover when turning:
questions.comment: The lower and more symmetrical the vehicle's center of gravity, the more stable it is. An empty car without a load is always more resistant to rollover than with it.

questions.question: How to provide first aid for frostbite and hypothermia?

answers.text: Rub the affected areas of the body with snow or wool, then insulate them, give them alcohol, and move them to a warm room
Insulate the affected areas of the body and immobilize them, wrap the victim in warm clothes or a blanket, give a warm drink, move to a warm room
Lubricate the affected areas of the body with cream, apply a warm compress and a heating pad, move to a warm room, give a warm drink

questions.comment: Hypothermia and frostbite are different conditions of the human body and its parts. In case of mild to moderate severity of these conditions, first aid should be provided to the victims in accordance with the answer, which indicates the actions in the sequence: insulate, wrap the victim, give him a warm drink, move him to a warm room.

questions.question: What kind of license is enough for a driver driving a truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons, but not more than 7.5 tons, and a trailer with a permissible maximum weight of more than 750 kg?

answers.text: For the right to drive a vehicle of subcategory “C1”
For the right to drive a category “C” vehicle
For the right to drive vehicles of category “C1E”

questions.comment: According to Article 25, paragraph 1 of the Federal Law “On Road Safety”, in order to drive a truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons, but not more than 7.5 tons, and a trailer with a maximum permissible weight of more than 750 kg, you must have a driver’s license for the right to drive a vehicle of category “C1E”. (Clause 2.1.1 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Signs warn you that:

answers.text: Pedestrians may appear on the roadway within 150 m
After 150 m there is a pedestrian crossing
After 150 m there is a pedestrian path

questions.comment: Under the sign 1.22 "Pedestrian crossing", a sign 8.1.1 "Distance to the object" is installed, indicating the distance to the dangerous area, about which the warning sign informs.(“Traffic Signs”)

questions.question: You are allowed to continue driving:
questions.comment: According to sign 4.3 “Roundabout”, you are entering an intersection where traffic is allowed only in the direction of the arrows shown on the sign. Oncoming traffic along trajectory “В” is prohibited. Turning right along path “А” is prohibited by sign 3.18.1 “Turning right is prohibited.” From the indicated directions, you can continue moving only along trajectory “Б”. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: When driving which car are you required to comply with the requirements of this sign?

answers.text: A truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons
A truck with a “Dangerous Goods” identification sign installed

questions.comment: Sign 4.8.2 “Direction of movement of vehicles with dangerous goods” indicates the mandatory direction of movement of vehicles equipped with the identification sign “Dangerous goods.” (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Is it possible for you to overtake if there are these markings?

answers.text: It is possible if the tractor speed is less than 30 km/h

questions.comment: Marking 1.11 is allowed to be crossed from the side of the broken line, as well as from the side of the solid line, but only when overtaking or going around an obstacle is completed. In this situation, you can overtake, regardless of the speed of the tractor. (“Horizontal marking”)

questions.question: In what directions does the traffic controller allow you to move?
questions.comment: With this position of the traffic controller on the left and right sides, trackless vehicles are allowed to move straight and to the right. “Chest, back - wall” - movement is prohibited for everyone from the chest and back. (Clause 6.10 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: When should you turn on your turn signals?

answers.text: Just before a turn or a U-turn
Well in advance of the maneuver
At the discretion of the driver

questions.comment: Your actions should always be clear to other road users. You must inform about your intentions in advance of the maneuver. (Clause 8.2 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Who should give way?

answers.text: Driver intending to start driving from the curb
Driver intending to stop at the curb
In this situation, drivers should act by mutual agreement

questions.comment: A driver intending to start moving after stopping or parking is required to give a signal in the appropriate direction and start moving only after making sure that the maneuver will be safe and will not interfere with other road users. (Clause 8.1 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Are you allowed to make a U-turn at this location?

answers.text: Permitted if it does not interfere with the movement of route vehicles

questions.comment: Turning around at places where route vehicles stop is prohibited under any circumstances. (Clause 8.11 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Which trajectory are you allowed to continue on?
questions.comment: Drivers turning onto a reversible road marked 5.10 must drive in the far right lane. Changing lanes is allowed only after the driver is convinced that traffic in this direction is also permitted in other lanes. You can continue driving from the indicated trajectories only along trajectory “Б”. (“Road signs”, paragraph 9.8 of the traffic rules)
topic: Location of vehicles on the roadway

questions.question: Is it possible for you to continue driving in the left lane outside populated areas after getting ahead of a truck?

answers.text: Yes, if you drive an intercity bus

questions.comment: At the end of the lead, the driver should change to the previously occupied lane. In this case, to the right. Outside the locality, drivers should drive vehicles as close as possible to the right edge of the carriageway. You have this opportunity, continue driving only on the far right lane.(Clause 9.4 of the Traffic Rules)
topic: Location of vehicles on the roadway

questions.question: Is a truck driver prohibited from stopping at this location?

answers.text: Prohibited if the distance between the car and the marking line is less than 3 m

questions.comment: Stopping is prohibited in places where the distance between the solid marking line and the stopped vehicle is less than 3 m. In this situation, a broken marking line 1.5 is marked on the roadway, separating traffic flows in opposite directions. There are no prohibiting factors for stopping in this situation. The driver of a truck is allowed to stop at this place. (Clause 12.4 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Are you allowed to enter an intersection beyond which there is a traffic jam:

answers.text: Allowed if you intend to make a turn

questions.comment: The intersection is controlled. You have a green light, but there is a traffic jam ahead. If you enter an intersection to move in the forward direction, then when the signals change, you will interfere with traffic, especially in the transverse direction. Therefore, you can only go to the intersection to turn right or left. (Clause 6.2, 13.2 of the Traffic Regulations). (the correct answer option was updated on December 14, 2018. Now you can’t go to an intersection with a traffic jam if you are going to make a U-turn)

questions.question: You intend to continue moving in a forward direction. What are your actions?
questions.comment: The intersection is unregulated, equal. When wiring vehicles we are guided by the “right hand rule”, i.e. whoever has an obstacle on the right concedes. You are obliged to give way to the truck. (Clause 13.11 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Who do you have to give way to when turning left?
questions.comment: The intersection is unequal. The main road changes direction. Vehicles on the main road have priority. And among themselves they are guided by the “right hand rule”. There is no interference on your right. You pass first, the driver of the car after you, the bus last, since it is on a secondary road. (Clause 13.9, 13.10, 13.11 Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Is reversing allowed on the motorway?

answers.text: Permitted if the vehicle is to the right of the solid marking line marking the edge of the carriageway of the highway

questions.comment: Reversing on the highway is prohibited. (Clause 16.1 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Under which of the following conditions can no more than 8 people be transported in the back of a truck, including passengers in the cabin?

answers.text: Only if you have a driver’s license for the right to drive a vehicle of category “С”, regardless of the length of experience driving a vehicle of this category
Only if you have a driver’s license for the right to drive a category “С” vehicle for more than 1 year
If you have a driver’s license for the right to drive a vehicle of category “С” or subcategory “С1” for 3 or more years

questions.comment: According to clause 22.1 of the traffic rules, the correct answer is if you have had a license for 3 or more years.

questions.question: Further movement of the vehicle (even to the place of parking or repair) with the headlights and tail lights off (absent) is prohibited:

answers.text: In both of the above cases

questions.comment: It is prohibited to drive if there is a malfunction - unlit (missing) headlights and rear parking lights in the dark or in conditions of insufficient visibility. The correct answer is in both of the above cases. (Clause 2.3.1 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Malfunctions and conditions for admitting vehicles to operation

questions.question: A method of turning around using the adjacent territory on the left, ensuring traffic safety, is shown:
questions.comment: The most rational and safe way to turn around in the situations shown is in the right figure. It allows you to better view the roadway and requires less time to turn.

questions.question: The likelihood of an emergency occurring when driving in heavy traffic will be less if the speed of your vehicle:

answers.text: Significantly less than average flow rate
Significantly higher than average flow rate

questions.comment: The movement of your car should not differ from the movement of the stream. The number of lane changes should be kept to a minimum. A driver who does not comply with these conditions creates unnecessary dangerous situations.

questions.question: The main road is shown:

answers.text: Only in the top left picture
In the top left and bottom pictures

questions.comment: The main road is shown in the upper left and lower pictures, on which there are priority signs in front of the intersection. (Clause 1.2 the term “Main Road.” “Road Signs”)

questions.question: Which of the following signs are valid only for the period of time when the roadway surface is wet?
questions.comment: Only the combination of signs “А” - 3.24 “Maximum speed limit” with sign 8.16 “Wet surface”, indicating that the sign applies to the period when the road surface is wet - is the correct answer. Sign “Б” - 1.18 “Gravel release” - warns about a section of the road on which gravel, crushed stone and the like can be released from under the wheels of vehicles. Sign “В” - 1.15 “Slippery road” - warns about a section of the road with increased Slippery roadway. The reason for this may be snowfall, icing, bitumen spills during road work, etc. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Are you allowed to park your car in the designated area?

answers.text: Permitted if you serve a business located in a designated area

questions.comment: Table 8.2.2 “Validity area” indicates that the coverage area of sign 3.28 “No parking” extends 50 m from the sign. You will clearly break the rules if you park your car in a given place if the distance from the sign to the car is less than 50 m. Although it is not easy to accurately determine such distances by eye, both in the picture and in practice. Remember the correct answer - PROHIBITED. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: You are driving a truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons. In which direction are you allowed to continue driving?
questions.comment: Sign 3.4 “Truck traffic prohibited” applies only to trucks with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons. Your vehicle belongs to this class. Sign 6.15.2 “Traffic direction for trucks” is advisory, i.e. optional. Therefore, at the intersection you can turn right, left, or turn around and continue driving in the opposite direction. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: This vertical marking indicates:

answers.text: All vertical elements of road structures
Only vertical elements of road structures that pose a danger to moving vehicles
Only vertical elements of road structures on highways and roads marked with sign 5.3 "Road for motor vehicles"

questions.comment: Vertical markings 2.1 indicate elements of road structures when these elements pose a danger to moving vehicles.

questions.question: Which vehicles are allowed to continue driving?

answers.text: Both vehicles are prohibited from moving

questions.comment: The intersection is adjustable. Traffic lights in the presence of a regulator "do not work". On the left side, with such a gesture of the adjuster, subject to the location of the vehicle on the roadway, movement in all directions is allowed. Both drivers continue driving.(Clauses 6.10, 6.15, 13.3 of the Traffic Rules)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: You intend to make a U-turn at an intersection. Which turn signals must be turned on before entering an intersection?

answers.text: There is no need to turn on the turn signals

questions.comment: Entering a roundabout corresponds to turning right. Turn on the right turn signal accordingly. Moving in a circle, you do not change the direction of movement. You don't use signals. When leaving the intersection, again make a right turn and again turn on the right turn signal in advance. (“Road signs”, paragraph 8.1 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: On what trajectory are you allowed to make a left turn?
questions.comment: Before turning left or right, the driver must take the extreme position on the roadway in advance. The road is one-way, leaving it is no exception. Therefore, you should make a left turn along trajectory “Б”. (“Road signs”, paragraph 8.5 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: The truck driver in this situation:

answers.text: Must give way to the car that is on his right
Must give way to a vehicle moving in the acceleration lane
Has an advantage over a car moving in the acceleration lane

questions.comment: The driver of a car enters the road from the acceleration lane. He is obliged to give way to vehicles moving on this road. (Clause 8.10 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: What should be decisive when a driver chooses a driving speed at night?

answers.text: Limit speed limits set by the Rules
Maximum design speed established by the technical characteristics of the vehicle used

questions.comment: A very important point when driving at night is the choice of speed. In this case, the main condition should be taken into account - the driver’s visibility distance of the road must exceed the stopping distance. (“Driving techniques.” Driving at night)

questions.question: Can you overtake a tractor?

answers.text: It is possible if overtaking is completed no closer than 100 m before the crossing

questions.comment: Overtaking is prohibited at railway crossings and closer than 100 m in front of them. In this situation, the action takes place outside the populated area, according to sign 1.4.1 “Approaching a railway crossing”, the distance to the railway crossing is at least 150-300 m. Therefore, you can overtake the tractor if you are sure that you will have time to complete it 100 m before the crossing. (“Road signs”, paragraph 11.4 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Where is parking allowed for long-term rest or overnight stay on roads outside the populated area?

answers.text: Only in a clearly visible place on the side of the road
Only in designated areas or off the road
In any of the listed places

questions.comment: Parking for the purpose of long-term rest, overnight stay, and the like outside a populated area is permitted only in areas provided for this purpose or outside the road. (Clause 12.3 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: When you turn on the green traffic light, you should:

answers.text: Start driving, making sure that there are only pedestrians completing the crossing of the roadway
Start driving, making sure that there are no pedestrians or vehicles completing the movement after the traffic light changes

questions.comment: The truck blocks visibility on the right, from where pedestrians may suddenly appear if they start moving after the traffic light changes. You should make sure that there are no vehicles completing their movement through the intersection. Therefore, proceed with the utmost caution. (Clause 13.8 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: You intend to drive straight through the intersection. Who do you have to give way to?
questions.comment: The intersection is equal. Under equal conditions, the tram has an advantage, and trackless vehicles are guided by the “right hand rule”, i.e. whoever has an obstacle on the right concedes. You give way to both the tram and the truck, which will pass the intersection at the same time, because their trajectories do not intersect. (Clause 13.11 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Who should you give way to when turning left?
questions.comment: The intersection is unequal. The main road changes direction. Advantage is given to vehicles located on the main road, which are guided by the “right-hand rule” among themselves. You pass first, because for a passenger car you are an obstacle on the right, and the bus is on a secondary road. (Clause 13.3, 13.10 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Are you allowed to enter the railway crossing in this situation?

answers.text: Allowed if there is no approaching train

questions.comment: It is prohibited to enter the crossing when the traffic light is prohibiting, regardless of the position and presence of the barrier. (Clause 15.3 of the Traffic Regulations). Violation of the rules for crossing railway crossings is one of the most serious violations of the Rules. Keep in mind that according to Article 12.10 part 1 of the Code of Administrative Offenses of the Russian Federation, for driving a railway crossing at a prohibiting signal, crossing railway tracks outside the crossing, stopping and parking on it, a penalty is provided - a fine of 5,000 rubles. or deprivation of rights for 3-6 months.

questions.question: When driving in poor visibility conditions, you can use fog lights:

answers.text: Only separately from low or high beam headlights
Only in combination with low or high beam headlights
Both separately and together with low or high beam headlights

questions.question: It is prohibited to operate buses (categories М2 and М3) if the remaining tire tread depth (in the absence of wear indicators) is no more than:

topic: Malfunctions and conditions for admitting vehicles to operation

questions.question: When approaching the top of a climb at night, the driver should:

answers.text: Do not switch high beam headlights to low beam
Switch high beam headlights to low beam only when an oncoming vehicle appears
Always switch high beam headlights to low beam

topic: Use of external lighting fixtures and audible signals

questions.question: What is the first aid for a traumatic brain injury accompanied by a wound to the scalp?

answers.text: Stop bleeding with direct pressure on the wound and apply a pressure bandage. If you lose consciousness, place yourself in a stable lateral position. If possible, apply cold to the head.

Fix the cervical spine using an improvised cervical splint (collar). Apply a sterile cotton swab to the wound and place the victim on his back with his legs raised. If possible, apply cold to the head.
Do not apply a cervical splint, seal the wound with a medical plaster, lay the victim on his side

questions.comment: The sequence of actions in the first aid is as follows - to stop the bleeding by direct pressure on the wound and apply a pressure bandage. In case of loss of consciousness, give a stable lateral position. If possible, apply cold to the head.

questions.question: What vehicles are classified as route vehicles?

answers.text: Buses (including small, intercity and school buses)
Buses, trolleybuses, trams used for regular transportation of passengers and luggage, moving along a set route with designated stopping places
Any vehicles carrying passengers and luggage moving along a route with stops

questions.comment: Route vehicles include buses, trolleybuses, trams, used for regular transportation of passengers and luggage, moving along an established route with designated stopping places. Clause 1.2 of the Traffic Regulations.

questions.question: When moving in a populated area, you can continue driving:

answers.text: In any of the directions indicated

questions.comment: In a populated area indicated by a corresponding sign with a white background, on this road the driver can use any lane convenient for him (Clause 9.4 of the Traffic Regulations). Sign 4.1.4 “Move straight or to the right” extends its effect to the first intersection of the roadways in front of which it is installed. Route vehicles may deviate from the effect of the sign. In this situation, marking 1.11 (solid line with broken line) has no meaning for you. (Whether it exists or not, for example, it is covered with snow). You are not allowed to turn around along trajectory “В”. According to paragraph 8.5 of the traffic rules, you cannot make a right turn, because you are not in the far right lane. You can continue driving only in direction “Б”. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: This sign indicates:

answers.text: Distance to the end of the tunnel
Direction of movement to the emergency exit and distance to it

questions.comment: The tunnel uses road sign 6.21.1 “Direction to the emergency exit.” It indicates the direction of movement to the emergency exit and the distance to it. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: To what extent does this sign apply?

answers.text: To the nearest intersection in the direction of travel
To the place where the sign “End of the maximum speed limit zone” is installed
To the end of the village

questions.comment: The effect of sign 5.31 “Zone with maximum speed limit” is canceled only by sign 5.32 “End of zone with maximum speed limit.” (“Road signs”)

questions.question: These lane markings are:

answers.text: Provides you with an advantage when rearranging to the right lane
Informs you that the road turns right
Warns you that you are approaching a narrowing of the carriageway

questions.comment: Marking 1.19 warns of approaching a narrowing of the roadway (the number of traffic lanes in this direction decreases). (“Horizontal markings”)

questions.question: It is prohibited to overtake a vehicle that has special color schemes applied to its external surfaces:

answers.text: Only when a special sound signal is turned on
Only when blue (blue and red) flashing lights are turned on
If both of the above conditions are present

questions.comment: Mandatory conditions for the prohibition of overtaking the “operative” (and the vehicles accompanied by him) are: 1 - special colorographic schemes applied to the outer surfaces; 2 - turning on blue or blue and red flashing lights on it; 3 - turning on the alarm sound signal. The correct answer is if all conditions are met. (Clause 3.2 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Are you required to give a right turn signal in this situation?
questions.comment: You will be rebuilt. Before changing lanes, you should give a right turn signal. (“Road signs”, “Horizontal markings” 1.19, clause 8.1 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: On what trajectory are you allowed to make a right turn on a small bus?
questions.comment: When turning right, the vehicle should move as close as possible to the right edge of the roadway. You have such an opportunity; when turning right, continue driving along trajectory “А”. (Clause 8.6 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: You can make a U-turn:

answers.text: Along any trajectory of the specified

questions.comment: U-turns are prohibited at pedestrian crossings (trajectories “Б”). You can do it before or behind the pedestrian crossing, in this case along the “А” or “В” trajectory. (Clause 8.11 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: In what cases is it permissible to drive outside the right lane if you are driving a vehicle whose speed should not exceed 40 km/h?

answers.text: Only when changing lanes before turning left or making a U-turn
In all of the above cases

questions.comment: Vehicles whose speed should not exceed 40 km/h or which for technical reasons cannot reach such a speed must move in the far right lane, except in cases of detour, overtaking or changing lanes before turning left, making a U-turn or stopping in permitted cases on the left side of the road. The correct answer is in all of the listed cases. (Clause 9.5 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Location of vehicles on the roadway

questions.question: The driver of the vehicle being overtaken:

answers.text: Must move as far to the right as possible
Must not impede overtaking by increasing speed or other actions

questions.comment: The driver of an overtaken vehicle is prohibited from preventing overtaking by increasing the speed or other actions. (Clause 11.3 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Which driver violated the parking rules?

answers.text: Only the driver of vehicle А
Only the driver of vehicle Б

questions.comment: Parking is prohibited closer than 50 m from railway crossings. Both drivers are violators, since the distance is less than required. (Clause 12.5 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: When turning right, are you required to give way to a car making a U-turn?
questions.comment: When driving “under an additional section” that is turned on simultaneously with the main red traffic light, you are obliged to give way to ALL moving from other directions, regardless of their further direction of movement. (Clause 13.5 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: In what case do you have the right to pass the intersection first?

answers.text: When driving straight, left and in the opposite direction

questions.comment: The intersection is equal. Drivers are guided by the “right hand rule”, i.e. whoever has an obstacle on the right concedes. There is an obstacle on the right side of the driver of a car. You pass the intersection first when driving straight and to the left. When turning, there will be an obstacle on your right. (Clause 13.11 of traffic rules)

questions.question: You intend to continue straight ahead. When the traffic light is flashing yellow, you should:

answers.text: Give way only to the tram

questions.comment: When the traffic light is flashing yellow, the intersection is unregulated. According to the priority signs - unequal. Vehicles on the main road have priority. You pass first, without yielding to anyone, since the tram and truck are on a secondary road. (Clause 13.3, 13.9 of traffic rules)

questions.question: In what cases can you drive straight while driving a truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons?

answers.text: In case of loading or unloading a vehicle in a designated area
In both of the above cases

questions.comment: Through traffic is prohibited through residential areas marked with signs, as well as courtyard areas. If you do not have the goal of carrying out through traffic, but have the goal of loading or unloading in a designated residential area, then you can drive through the intersection in the forward direction. (“Road signs”, paragraphs 17.2, 17.4 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Standards for driving and rest time apply to individuals operating:

answers.text: Trucks with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons

questions.comment: Standards for vehicle driving and rest time apply to individuals operating trucks with a maximum permissible weight exceeding 3,500 kilograms, and buses (Clause 26.4 of the Traffic Regulations). These individuals, at the request of officials authorized to carry out federal state supervision in the field of road safety, provide access to the tachograph and the driver card used in conjunction with the tachograph, and also, at the request of these officials, print information from the tachograph.
topic: Use of external lighting fixtures and audible signals

questions.question: In what cases are drivers held criminally liable for violations of the Rules that lead to serious consequences?

answers.text: Only when causing death to a person
When causing death to a person or serious harm to human health
If there is a victim (regardless of the severity of the injuries he received) or major material damage has been caused

questions.comment: According to Art. 264 of the Criminal Code of the Russian Federation, drivers are held criminally liable for violations of traffic rules and operating rules. when causing death to a person or serious harm to human health. “Criminal Code of the Russian Federation”.

questions.question: If you stop on an uphill (downhill) slope and there is a sidewalk, you can prevent the bus from rolling away spontaneously by turning its front wheels to the position:
questions.comment: To prevent the bus from unintentionally rolling away, turn the wheels so that they rest against the sidewalk curb. This prevents the further movement of the bus (“А” and “В”). And, conversely, in the absence of support, the bus may spontaneously roll onto the roadway (“Б” and “Г”). This measure is additional to mandatory measures, i.e. using the parking brake and preferably engaging a lower gear or reverse gear. (Clause 12.8 of the Traffic Regulations. “Commentary on the Traffic Regulations of the Russian Federation,” publishing house “Za Rulem”)

questions.question: What distance will the vehicle travel in a time equal to the average reaction time of the driver at a speed of about 90 km/h?
questions.comment: The car's speedometer does not show an absolutely accurate speed value. If the speedometer speed is about 90 km/h, which is equivalent to 90,000 meters/hour or 90,000 meters: 3,600 seconds = approximately 25 meters in 1 second.

questions.question: In what cases can the owner of a truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 7.5 tons transfer control of this vehicle in his presence to another person, having an insurance policy of compulsory civil liability insurance on paper or in the form of an electronic document or a copy thereof on paper?

answers.text: If this person has a driver’s license for the right to drive a vehicle of subcategory “С1”
If this person has a driver’s license for the right to drive a category “С” vehicle
In both of the above cases

questions.comment: According to Art. 25 clause 1 of the Federal Law “On Road Safety”, the owner of a truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 7.5 tons can transfer control of this vehicle in his presence to another person, having the appropriate insurance policy on paper or in the form of an electronic document or a copy thereof, printed on paper, if this person has a driver’s license for the right to drive a category “С” vehicle. (Clause 2.1.1 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: This sign:

answers.text: Warns you about the presence of a narrow section of road, but does not set the order of traffic
Prohibits you from crossing the bridge
Obliges you to give way to oncoming traffic

questions.comment: Sign 2.6 “Right of way for oncoming traffic” prohibits driving onto a narrow section of the road if this may impede oncoming traffic. Therefore, you should give way to a truck approaching the bridge. (“Road signs”, paragraph 1.2, the term “Give way”)

questions.question: In which directions can you continue driving your truck?

answers.text: Only left and in the opposite direction

questions.comment: Sign 5.13.2 “Entering a road with a lane for route vehicles” prohibits turning right. Therefore, you can continue driving straight, left, or turn around to drive in the opposite direction. (“Road Signs”)

questions.question: What vehicles are prohibited from parking on weekends and holidays?

answers.text: Only for trucks with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 t

questions.comment: Plaque 8.5.1 “Saturdays, Sundays and holidays”, installed under sign 5.27 “Restricted parking area” with the image of a truck, which indicates that the sign applies to trucks, incl. and with trailer, r.m.m. which is more than 3.5 tons (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Movement is permitted:

answers.text: Along any trajectory of the specified

questions.comment: Horizontal marking line 1.11 is allowed to be crossed from the broken side, as well as from the solid side, but only when overtaking or detour is completed. Driver “А” leaving the yard violates the Rules. A vehicle making a U-turn along trajectory “Б” is allowed to move (“Horizontal marking”)

questions.question: What is the significance of the whistle signal given by the traffic controller?

answers.text: The signal is given to attract the attention of traffic participants

questions.comment: An additional whistle signal is given to attract the attention of traffic participants. (Clause 6.12 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: You intend to turn left at this intersection. At what point should the left turn signals be turned on?

answers.text: In advance, before entering the intersection
After entering the first intersection of carriageways

questions.comment: The rules require you to warn other road users in advance of a change of intent in traffic. The signal you give should not mislead other drivers. In the situation under consideration, it is necessary to turn on the direction indicator after entering the first intersection of the carriageways.(Clauses 8.1, 8.2 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: Who must give way when changing lanes at the same time?

answers.text: In this situation, drivers should act by mutual agreement

questions.comment: When changing lanes at the same time, drivers are guided by the “right-hand rule.” Interference with the driver of a car. He gives way. (Clause 8.4 of traffic rules)

questions.question: Are you allowed to make a U-turn on the bridge along the specified trajectory while driving a small bus?

answers.text: Allowed only when road visibility is at least 100 m

questions.comment: U-turns on bridges are prohibited for all types of transport. (Clause 8.11 of traffic rules)

questions.question: What is the maximum speed a truck driver is allowed to travel at?
questions.comment: The driver must not exceed the speed indicated on the “Speed Limit” identification sign that marks the vehicle, in this case a truck. (“Road Signs”, paragraph 10.4 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Are you allowed to overtake in this situation?

answers.text: Allowed if overtaking is completed before the intersection

questions.comment: Warning sign 1.6 "Crossing of equivalent roads" is installed outside the settlement 150-300 m before the intersection. Overtaking is prohibited at such intersections. You can overtake in the shown situation, but it must be completed before the border of the intersection.("Traffic Signs", clause 11.4 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: Is it possible for you to park a truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons at the specified location?

answers.text: Yes, if you are driving a vehicle with a permissible maximum weight of no more than 7.5 tons

questions.comment: The action takes place in a populated area on a road with one lane in each direction, without tram tracks in the middle. On such roads, as an exception, any type of vehicle is allowed to stop and park on the left side of the road in the direction of travel. But sign 5.27 “Zone with parking restrictions”, unlike sign 3.28 “Parking prohibited”, extends to the entire territory (road section) and its effect is not interrupted until sign 5.28 “End of zone with parking restrictions”. Parking is prohibited on this section of the road. (“Road signs”, clause 12.1 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: You intend to turn right. What are your actions?

answers.text: Turn right without giving way to pedestrians
Turn right, giving way to pedestrians
Stop before the intersection and wait for another signal from the traffic controller

questions.comment: The traffic controller's arms are lowered (“Chest, back - wall”). From the right and left sides, trackless vehicles are allowed to move straight and to the right, pedestrians are allowed to cross the roadway. (Clause 6.10 of the Traffic Regulations). When turning right, you are required to give way to pedestrians crossing the roadway you are turning onto. (Clause 13.1 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: When driving in which direction should you give way to a car with a flashing light and a special sound signal on?
questions.comment: You are obliged to ensure unimpeded passage of the intersection for the “operative” with special signals turned on, regardless of the direction of his movement. This must be done when driving in any direction. (Clause 3.1, 3.2 of traffic rules)

questions.question: You intend to continue straight ahead. What to do when the traffic light is flashing yellow?

answers.text: Give way only to the tram

questions.comment: When the traffic light is flashing yellow, the intersection is unregulated and unequal. The main road changes direction. Advantage is given to vehicles located on the main road, which among themselves are guided by the “right hand rule”, i.e. whoever has an obstacle on the right concedes. You have an obstacle on the right, give way only to a passenger car. (“Road signs”, paragraphs 13.3, 13.9, 13.10, 13.11 Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Is practice driving allowed on the motorway?

answers.text: Allowed only in the far right lane

questions.comment: Driving practice on a highway marked with sign 5.1 “Motorway” is permitted from 2020 (Clause 16.1 of the Traffic Regulations).
topic: Training riding and additional requirements for the movement of cyclists

questions.question: When driving at night on unlit sections of roads, you can use fog lights:

answers.text: Only separately from low or high beam headlights
Only in combination with low or high beam headlights
Both separately and together with low or high beam headlights

questions.comment: At night, high or low beam headlights must be turned on on unlit sections of roads. Fog lights can only be turned on in addition to the main lighting. (Clause 19.4 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Use of external lighting fixtures and audible signals

questions.question: What malfunction of the brake system prevents further movement of a truck and bus?

answers.text: Parking brake warning light does not turn on
The pressure gauge of the pneumatic or pneumohydraulic brake drive does not work

questions.comment: A pressure gauge is a mandatory device in the service brake system of a pneumatic or pneumohydraulic brake drive. If the pressure gauge does not work, then, accordingly, some kind of malfunction has occurred in the service brake system. In this case, according to paragraph 2.3.1 of the Rules, further movement of the vehicle is prohibited. (In this case, a truck or bus).
topic: Malfunctions and conditions for admitting vehicles to operation

questions.question: A method of turning around using the adjacent territory on the right, ensuring traffic safety, is shown:
questions.comment: In the left picture, when leaving the adjacent territory, you look at the intersection of roadways in the usual manner. In the right picture, you must move in reverse across the intersection of roadways, which requires more time and limits visibility.

questions.question: How should the victim be positioned if he loses consciousness and has breathing and circulation to provide first aid?

answers.text: On your back with a cushion under your head
On your back with legs extended
Place the victim in a stable side position so that the knees are bent on the ground and the top hand is under the cheek

questions.comment: To prevent the victim from dying from suffocation as a result of a stuck tongue, he should be placed on his side so that his bent knees rest on the ground and his upper hand is under his cheek.

questions.question: Do the driver's actions comply with the Rules if he is driving in the middle of the road?

answers.text: Compliant if there are no oncoming vehicles

questions.comment: The driver must occupy the side of the road intended for traffic in a given direction. Since we drive on the right, he must take the right side of the road. Driving in the middle of the road is a violation. (Clause 1.4, 9.1 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Location of vehicles on the roadway

questions.question: What should you do if you need to turn around?

answers.text: Turn around at this intersection if there are no other vehicles at it
Drive straight and turn around at the intersection
Drive straight and turn around only at the next intersection

questions.comment: The effect of sign 4.1.1 “Move straight”, installed before the intersection of roadways, extends to the first intersection behind the sign. In this case, it applies to the entire intersection. Therefore, if you decide to turn around, you have no choice but to drive through the intersection and turn around on the section of road that follows, i.e. behind the intersection. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Are you allowed to park in the indicated location?

answers.text: Allowed only with activated hazard warning lights

questions.comment: The coverage area of sign 3.27 “No stopping” in this situation is from the installation site to the nearest intersection. There is also a break in the dividing strip for turning around. Parking in the indicated place is prohibited. (“Road signs”, paragraph 1.2 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: This plate extends the effect of the sign installed with it:

answers.text: Only for trucks with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons

questions.comment: Table 8.4.1 “Type of vehicle” applies the sign to trucks, including those with a trailer, with r.m.m. more than 3.5 t. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Which pedestrian crossing does this marking indicate?
questions.comment: Marking 1.14.1 (“zebra”), using a yellow background, in order to enhance its perception by drivers and, accordingly, increase the safety of pedestrians, is often used. It can designate any pedestrian crossing - both regulated and unregulated. (“Road markings”)

questions.question: What are your actions in this situation?

answers.text: Pass the crossing, making sure there is no approaching train
Stop at the traffic light and then pass the crossing
Wait until the white-lunar flashing signal turns off and pass the crossing

questions.comment: This white-moon flashing traffic light signal is equivalent to the green signal of a regular traffic light. It allows the movement of vehicles through the railway crossing. Pass the crossing, making sure that there is no approaching train. (Clause 6.9 of traffic rules)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: When can the hand signal for a turn be stopped?

answers.text: Immediately before the start of the maneuver
After the start of the maneuver
Only after the end of the maneuver

questions.comment: The hand signal can be completed just before the maneuver. At the same time, the signal should not mislead other road users.(Clause 8.2 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: From which lane is it allowed to enter this intersection?
questions.comment: As an exception, entry to an intersection with a roundabout can be done from any lane in that direction. Departure from the intersection is carried out according to the general rules. (Clause 8.5 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Are you allowed to make a U-turn on this section of the road?

answers.text: Permitted only when road visibility is at least 100 m

questions.comment: There's a turn ahead. Houses and trees limit the view of the road. A U-turn is possible only if the road in the direction of travel is visible at a distance of at least 100 m. (Clause 8.11 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: At what maximum speed do you have the right to continue driving a truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons?
questions.comment: On the section of the road marked with this sign (blue background), the clauses of the Rules that establish the rules of movement in populated areas do not apply. On a truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons, you can continue driving at a speed of no more than 70 km/h (“Road signs”, paragraph 10.3 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: How many vehicles can you overtake at the same time after passing through a pedestrian crossing?
questions.comment: The rules do not stipulate the number of vehicles overtaken. It is forbidden to overtake at pedestrian crossings. There are no factors prohibiting overtaking. You can overtake all three vehicles. But it should always be remembered that overtaking is a classic type of driver risk.(Clauses 1.2, 11.1, 11.4 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: Are you allowed to stop on the bridge to pick up a passenger?
questions.comment: On bridges, overpasses and overpasses that have less than three lanes for traffic in a given direction, stopping is prohibited for all types of transport. In this situation, there are two lanes of traffic, therefore, if you stop, you will be violating the Rules. Attention! Do not confuse this question with a similar one (ticket 14, question 12), where there are three lanes. (Clause 12.4 of traffic rules)

questions.question: In this situation, you are not required to give way to the tram when moving:
questions.comment: The intersection is adjustable. A traffic light with a single-color signal, intended for route vehicles, allows straight ahead traffic. A tram turning right waits for the signal to change. A green traffic light allows you to move - drive straight through the intersection first. (Clause 6.2, 6.8 of traffic rules)

questions.question: Which driver making a turn must give way to pedestrians?
questions.comment: When turning right or left when passing through intersections, both regulated and unregulated, the driver is obliged to give way to pedestrians crossing the roadway onto which he is turning. Both drivers give way to pedestrians. (Clause 13.1 of traffic rules)

questions.question: Can you start turning left in this situation?

answers.text: You can, only after making sure that you do not interfere with an oncoming car making a left turn.

questions.comment: The intersection is unequal. Vehicles on the main road have priority. But since your trajectory does not intersect with the truck, you can move through the intersection at the same time, while you must take into account the advantage of the truck, i.e. do not interfere with him. (“Road signs”, paragraphs 1.2, the term “Give way”, 13.9 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: Are you allowed to drive in the right lane on a bus?

answers.text: Allowed if you are driving a route or school bus

questions.comment: According to sign 5.14.1 “Lane for route vehicles” and marking 1.23.1 (in the form of the letter “А”), the right lane belongs to route vehicles and vehicles used as passenger taxis, as well as cyclists and “school buses”. It is prohibited for other vehicles to drive or stop in this lane. You are allowed to drive in this lane if you are driving a route or school bus. (Clause 18.2 of the Traffic Regulations, “Horizontal markings” 1.23.1)

questions.question: Rear fog lights can be used:

answers.text: Only when driving in the dark
In both of the above cases

questions.comment: Rear fog lights can only be used in conditions of poor visibility. (Clause 19.7 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Use of external lighting fixtures and audible signals

questions.question: In the event of any malfunction, the further movement of the vehicle is prohibited even to the place of repair or parking?
questions.comment: If the steering system is faulty, movement poses a clear danger and is therefore prohibited. (Clause 2.3.1 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Malfunctions and conditions for admitting vehicles to operation

questions.question: While moving in a straight direction, you suddenly find yourself on a small section of slippery road. What should I do?

answers.text: Turn, steering wheel to drive off this stretch of road
Do not change the trajectory and speed of movement

questions.comment: If this is a really small section of the road, then it is necessary not to change the trajectory and speed in order to avoid skidding.

questions.question: For how long can a hemostatic tourniquet be applied?

answers.text: No more than half an hour in the warm season and no more than one hour in the cold season
No more than one hour in the warm season and no more than half an hour in the cold season
The time for applying the tourniquet is not limited

questions.comment: A hemostatic tourniquet is applied: in the warm season (+4°C and above) - for a period of no more than one hour, and for a period of no more than half an hour in the cold season (below +4°C).

questions.question: What does the term "Limited Visibility" mean?

answers.text: The driver's visibility of the road, limited by the terrain, geometric parameters of the road, vegetation, buildings, structures or other objects
Driver visibility of the road is less than 300 m in conditions of fog, rain, snowfall, and also at dusk
Driver visibility of the road is less than 150 m at night
Driver visibility of the road in all of the above cases

questions.comment: “Limited visibility” - the driver’s visibility of the road in the direction of travel, limited by the terrain, geometric parameters of the road, vegetation, buildings, structures or other objects, including vehicles. (Clause 1.2 of the traffic rules, the term “Limited visibility”)

questions.question: What are these signs warning you about?

answers.text: Stopping vehicles on the side of the road is prohibited
Driving to the side of the road is dangerous due to road works being carried out on it
Parking is prohibited at the road work site

questions.comment: Sign 1.25 “Road Works” in combination with plate 8.12 “Dangerous Shoulder” warns drivers that driving onto the side of the road is dangerous due to road (repair) work being carried out on it. (“Road Signs”)

questions.question: Which of the following signs permit the movement of trucks with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons?
questions.comment: Sign “Б” - 3.1 “Entry prohibited” - prohibits the entry of all vehicles. Route vehicles deviate from the requirements of the sign: trams, trolleybuses, buses. Sign “В” - 3.4 “Movement of trucks is prohibited” - in the absence of a number on the vehicle of the sign, it means that trucks can pass under the sign only if their r.m.m. no more than 3.5 tons. Sign “А” - 5.3 “Road for cars” - indicating a road intended only for cars (without restrictions), buses and motorcycles, any weight requirements, etc. does not present the listed vehicles. Of those listed, trucks with r.m.m. are allowed to move. more than 3.5 t only sign “А”. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: You can continue driving in the leftmost lane on the bus:
questions.comment: If there are signs that organize the direction of movement along lanes or along a lane, as in this situation, signs that allow a left turn from the extreme left lane also allow a U-turn from this lane. Therefore, you can continue driving straight, left, or turn around to continue driving in the opposite direction. (“Road signs” 5.15.2)

questions.question: In which of the indicated places are you allowed to cross the solid marking line and stop?

answers.text: In the indicated places it is prohibited to cross the solid marking line

questions.comment: This road has two adjacent carriageways. There is a dividing strip between them. On the left edge of the roadway there is a marking 1.2, which marks the edge of the roadway. The dividing strip is not intended for the movement and stopping of vehicles. (Location "А") In place “Б” - you can stop. Marking line 1.2 in this case marks the edge of the roadway. In such a situation, it is allowed to cross it to stop the vehicle on the side of the road and when leaving it in places where stopping or parking is permitted. (Clause 1.2, the term “Dividing strip”, “Horizontal markings”)

questions.question: Do you have to stop at the request of the traffic controller at the place indicated by him?

answers.text: Yes, but only by pulling onto the sidewalk

questions.comment: The traffic controller decided to stop you. In this case, his actions must be clear and specific. Initially, he must give you instructions to stop, i.e. the gesture of his hand should be directed towards your vehicle. After this, the traffic controller indicates the stopping place. Your task is to stop at the indicated place, even if it is contrary to the stopping rules. As in this situation, stopping at the sidewalk. (Clause 6.11 of the traffic rules)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: This hand signal from the motorcycle driver informs you:

answers.text: About his intention to turn left or make a U-turn
About his intention to continue moving straight or left
About the presence of a vehicle approaching from the left

questions.comment: The signal for a left turn or U-turn corresponds to the left hand extended to the side. The right outstretched arm, but bent at the elbow at a right angle upward, can also be used for such a signal. (Clause 8.1 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: On what trajectory are you allowed to make a left turn?
questions.comment: According to sign 5.7.2 “Entering a one-way road,” at this intersection you can continue moving straight, left, and make a U-turn. On a one-way road, you can drive in any lane. Therefore, you are allowed to move along any of the indicated trajectories. (“Road signs”, paragraph 8.6 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Can you turn around in this place?
questions.comment: The sign under the sign 8.2.1 “Coverage area” indicates the length of the dangerous turns that the sign 1.12.1 “Dangerous turns” warns about, and which is installed outside populated areas 150 - 300 m before the dangerous area. When making a turn, you should not find yourself in a place with visibility of the road in at least one direction less than 100 m. You still have a short distance at which you can make a turn. (“Road signs”, clause 8.11 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Are vehicles allowed on sidewalks or pedestrian paths?

answers.text: Allowed only when delivering goods to retail and other enterprises located directly next to sidewalks or pedestrian paths, if there are no other access options

questions.comment: Vehicles are allowed to drive on sidewalks or pedestrian paths only if you serve retail or other businesses located directly next to these sidewalks or paths, and there are no other access options. (Clause 9.9 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Location of vehicles on the roadway

questions.question: In this situation you:

answers.text: Must give way as the oncoming car is moving uphill
You have the right to pass first, as you are moving downhill
You have the right to pass first, since the obstacle is in the lane of the oncoming car.

questions.comment: Under normal conditions, the driver on whose side there is an obstacle is inferior. On slopes marked with appropriate signs, the procedure is different. If there is an obstacle, the driver of a vehicle moving downhill must give way. According to sign 1.13 “Steep descent”, you are guided by this rule and give way to an oncoming car moving uphill. (“Road signs”, clause 11.7 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Are you allowed to stop on the bridge at the indicated location?
questions.comment: Stopping on bridges, overpasses and overpasses is prohibited if the number of traffic lanes in a given direction is less than three. In this situation there are three lanes. You can stop. (Clause 12.4 of traffic rules)

questions.question: When you turn on the green traffic light, you must give way:

answers.text: Only for a truck completing a U-turn at an intersection

questions.comment: The rules provide for such a situation. When you turn on the permissive signal of the traffic light, the driver is obliged to give way to vehicles completing the movement through the intersection. You have such a situation - give way to all cars that are within the boundaries of the intersection, in this case - to both cars.(Clause 13.8 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: You intend to drive straight through the intersection. Who do you have to give way to?
questions.comment: The intersection is equal. In equal conditions, trams have an advantage. In this situation, the trams' trajectories do not intersect; they pass through the intersection simultaneously. You are after them. (Clause 13.11 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: When turning left you:

answers.text: Must give way only to buses
Must give way to cars and buses

questions.comment: The intersection is unequal. Vehicles located on the main road have priority. When turning left, you must give way to vehicles coming directly from the opposite direction. You must yield only to the bus. (Clause 13.9, 13.12 of traffic rules)

questions.question: Which drivers violate the rules for turning around on the highway?

answers.text: Only the driver of a truck performing road repair or maintenance work

questions.comment: On a highway, turning around in technological gaps in the dividing strip is prohibited (clause 16.1 of the traffic rules). But drivers of vehicles with a yellow or orange flashing light turned on when performing construction, repair or cleaning work may deviate from this requirement (clause 16.1) provided that traffic safety is ensured (clause 3.5 of the traffic rules). The driver of a small bus breaks the Rules.

questions.question: Is it legal to transport people on a cargo trailer?

answers.text: Allowed if they accompany the cargo

questions.comment: Under no circumstances is it permitted to transport people in a trailer. (Clause 22.8 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: In which of the following cases is it permissible to operate a car?

answers.text: Tires have tread or sidewall separation
Winter tires have retreaded anti-skid studs

questions.comment: It is not prohibited to operate a vehicle with “welded” tires, i.e. with a restored tread pattern, provided that the requirements of paragraph 5.9 of the “List of Faults” are met. Operation with tire defects listed in other answers is prohibited. (“List of faults” paragraph 5.6)
topic: Malfunctions and conditions for admitting vehicles to operation

questions.question: How does prolonged acceleration of a vehicle with first gear engaged affect fuel consumption?
questions.comment: Driving unnecessarily in lower gears increases fuel consumption.

questions.question: Is it safe to drive a truck at night with low beam headlights on an unlit section of the highway at a speed of 90 km/h?

answers.text: It is safe because the maximum permissible speed complies with the requirements of the Rules
Not safe because stopping distance exceeds visibility distance

questions.comment: The driver's visibility distance when the vehicle is moving must always exceed the stopping distance. Structurally, this condition with low beams on is ensured in the dark when the vehicle is moving at a speed of up to 60 km/h. Therefore, driving a truck under the specified driving conditions at a speed of 90 km/h is not safe, since the stopping distance will exceed the visibility distance. In your actions while driving, eliminate unnecessary risks, which often result in an accident. (“Driving Techniques”)

questions.question: What stationary object that does not allow you to continue moving along the lane does not belong to the concept of “Obstacle”?

answers.text: A vehicle stopped in this lane due to congestion

questions.comment: A traffic jam or a vehicle stopped in the traffic lane in accordance with the requirements of the Rules is not an obstacle (Clause 1.2 of the Traffic Regulations, the term “Obstacle”)

questions.question: You can continue driving at the intersection:
questions.comment: A median strip divides the road into carriageways. The effect of the sign 4.1.1 “Move straight”, installed in front of the intersection, applies only to the first intersection of the roadways behind the sign. Movement along trajectory “В” is prohibited. You can move along the trajectory “А” or “Б”. (“Road signs”, paragraph 1.2 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Parking is prohibited in the area covered by these signs:

answers.text: Only for trucks with a permissible maximum weight of more than 7.5 tons
Trucks with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons

questions.comment: Plate 8.4.1 “Type of vehicle” extends the effect of sign 3.28 “Parking prohibited” to trucks, including those with a trailer, with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Which of the following signs indicate the extent of the coverage area of the signs with which they are used?
questions.comment: Plates 8.2.1, 8.2.2 “Coverage area”, marked “Б” and “В”, indicate the coverage area of prohibiting signs. Plaque “А” 8.1.1 “Distance to object” indicates the exact distance from the sign to the beginning of the dangerous section, the place where any restriction is introduced or a certain object located ahead in the direction of travel. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Are you allowed to perform such a maneuver when the reversing traffic lights are turned off?

answers.text: Allowed if there are no oncoming vehicles

questions.comment: It is FORBIDDEN to cross the discontinuous line 1.9 of the horizontal marking separating the traffic flows of opposite directions when the reversing traffic lights are turned off.(“Horizontal markings”)

questions.question: With such traffic lights and a traffic controller’s gesture, you must:
questions.comment: The intersection is controlled. According to the “principle of traffic control priority,” traffic signals “do not work.” We are guided only by the signals of the traffic controller, whose raised hand prohibits the movement of all vehicles and pedestrians. In this case, drivers, if there is a stop line, must stop in front of it. The exception is vehicles that, when the traffic controller raises his hand up, cannot stop without resorting to emergency braking. (Clause 6.10, 6.13, 6.14 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: In this situation, is the driver stopped due to a malfunction required to display a warning triangle?

answers.text: Required if the hazard warning lights are faulty

questions.comment: When forced to stop in places where it is prohibited, the driver must turn on the hazard warning lights and display a warning triangle. An emergency stop sign is installed, regardless of the presence and serviceability of the hazard warning lights, in the lane on which the vehicle is located. (Clause 7.1, 7.2 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Use of hazard warning lights and warning triangles

questions.question: Which trajectory are you allowed to continue to the left?
questions.comment: When turning left, passing through an intersection, the driver himself determines the trajectory of movement, and the following condition must be met: the car must be on its side of the road when crossing the border of the roadways. You can continue driving along any of the indicated trajectories. (Clause 8.6 of traffic rules)

questions.question: How should you proceed when leaving a parking lot in a small bus at the same time as a passenger car?

answers.text: By mutual agreement with the driver of this vehicle

questions.comment: In parking lots, in the territories of warehouses, bases, in the field, etc. When driving around, drivers are guided by the “right-hand rule,” i.e. Whoever has an obstacle on the right along the trajectory of movement gives way. You are giving way to another car. (Clause 8.9 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: You can resort to sharp braking:

answers.text: To stop in front of an intersection or pedestrian crossing when the green traffic light changes to yellow
In both of the above cases

questions.comment: The rules allow the use of sudden (emergency) braking only to prevent a traffic accident. In other cases, service braking is used.(Clause 10.5 of the Traffic Rules, "Vehicle Control Technique")

questions.question: Is overtaking allowed at intersections on a two-lane road?

answers.text: Permitted only at intersections of unequal roads when driving on the main road

questions.comment: Overtaking is prohibited at equivalent intersections. It is allowed to overtake at unequal intersections when driving on the main road. (Clause 11.4 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Which driver violated the stopping rules?
questions.comment: Stopping on the left side of the road in the direction of travel is allowed only in populated areas. The driver of a passenger car, like the driver of a bus, is clearly violating the rules. The bus driver, if there was a shoulder, should have stopped on it. (Clause 12.1 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: In what case are you obliged to let the tram pass?

answers.text: When turning left, changing lanes onto tram tracks in the same direction
In both of the above cases

questions.comment: The intersection is regulated by a traffic light, the trajectories of the tram and yours intersect. Being in equivalent conditions, a tram has an advantage over trackless vehicles. You give way in both of these cases. (Clause 6.2, 13.6 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: When driving in a forward direction you should:

answers.text: Give way only to the tram
Give way to trams and cars

questions.comment: The intersection is equal. Under equal conditions, a tram has an advantage over trackless vehicles. Passes first. You and the driver of a car are guided by the “right-hand rule.” There is no interference on your right. Pass the intersection, giving way only to the tram. (Clause 13.11 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Who should you give way to when turning left?
questions.comment: The intersection is unequal. The main road changes direction. Vehicles on the main road have priority and are guided by the “right-hand rule” among themselves. There is an obstacle on your right, you give way to the bus. The passenger car will pass last, as it is on a secondary road. (Clause 13.9, 13.10, 13.11 Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: You are allowed to continue driving:

answers.text: Along any trajectory of the specified

questions.comment: When turning right, the vehicle should move as close to the right as possible. That's what you do. You turn into the outer lane, but you cannot continue driving along it, since according to the sign 5.14.1 “Lane for fixed-route vehicles” and markings 1.23.1 (in the form of the letter “А”), it is intended for the movement of fixed-route vehicles and vehicles used as passenger taxis, as well as cyclists and “school buses.” Therefore, you change lanes along the “Б” path into the adjacent lane. (Clause 8.6, 18.2 Traffic Regulations, “Road Signs”)

questions.question: To attract the attention of the driver of an overtaken vehicle when driving outside a populated area during daylight hours, you can:

answers.text: Only by briefly switching the headlights from low beam to high beam
Only by joint submission of the specified signals

questions.comment: To warn and attract the attention of the driver of an overtaken vehicle when driving outside a populated area, you can use a sound signal, or briefly switch the headlights from low beam to high beam, including the combined presentation of these signals. (Clause 19.10, 19.11 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Use of external lighting fixtures and audible signals

questions.question: At what maximum value of the total play in the steering is a truck allowed to be operated?
questions.comment: Operation of the truck is permitted if the total play in the steering does not exceed 25 degrees. (“List of faults” paragraph 2.3)
topic: Malfunctions and conditions for admitting vehicles to operation

questions.question: How should you choose a gear when braking with an engine, taking into account the steepness of the descent?

answers.text: The steeper the descent, the higher the gear
The steeper the descent, the lower the gear
Gear selection does not depend on the steepness of the descent

questions.comment: The driver can use this dependence of braking efficiency on steep descents, in a car with a manual gearbox, or switch to manual mode to select gears on automated gearboxes.

questions.question: What kind of injuries to the victim may be indicated by the “frog” pose (legs are bent at the knees and spread apart, and the feet are turned with the soles facing each other) and what first aid should be provided?

answers.text: The victim may have a bruise of the abdominal wall, a broken ankle, or a fracture of the bones of the foot. For first aid, stretch your legs and apply splints to both legs from the ankle to the armpit.

The victim may have fractures of the femoral neck, pelvic bones, spinal fractures, damage to the internal organs of the small pelvis, and internal bleeding. Do not change his position, do not stretch his legs, do not apply splints. For first aid, place a soft cloth cushion under your knees and, if possible, apply cold to your stomach.
The victim may have fractures of the lower leg and lower third of the thigh. During first aid, apply splints only to the injured leg from the ankle to the knee joint, without extending the leg.

questions.comment: The correct answer is the one that indicates a fracture of the spine. The forced pose of the "frog" in the victim should not be changed. Do not stretch your legs, do not apply tires.

questions.question: Under what conditions, in cases of a forced stop of a vehicle or a traffic accident, is the driver required to wear a jacket, vest or cape vest with stripes of reflective material?

answers.text: If this happened outside populated areas
If this happened in the dark or in conditions of limited visibility
If the driver is on the roadway or side of the road
If all the above conditions are present

questions.comment: According to paragraph 2.3.4 of the traffic rules, the driver of any vehicle is obliged, in the event of a forced stop of a vehicle or a traffic accident outside populated areas at night or in conditions of limited visibility while on the roadway or side of the road, to be dressed in a jacket, vest or cape vest with stripes of reflective material that meet the requirements of GOST 12.4.281-2014

questions.question: Which courtyard can you enter in this situation?

answers.text: Turns in the courtyards are prohibited
Just into the yard to the right
Just to the left in the yard

questions.comment: Sign 4.1.1 “Move straight” is installed behind the intersection of roadways, i.e. at the beginning of the road section. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Which of the following signs prohibits the further movement of all vehicles without exception?
questions.comment: Sign “Б” - 3.17.2 “Danger” prohibits the further movement of all vehicles without exception. It is necessary to understand that the sign is installed in places that threaten the life and health of people. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: What do these signs inform?

answers.text: Permitted speed no more than 40 km/h on wet surfaces
Recommended speed 40 km/h in wet conditions
Recommended speed no more than 40 km/h only during rain

questions.comment: The solid yellow marking line 1.4 indicates places where stopping is prohibited. Can be used independently. Its effect also extends to the side of the road where it is applied. questions.question: What should a driver do when changing such a traffic light?

answers.text: When the red signal is on, turn right, giving way to other road users
When the green signal is turned on, continue driving only to the right
These steps are correct in both cases.

questions.comment: Traffic light signals, made in the form of red, yellow and green arrows, have the same meaning as round signals of the corresponding color, but their effect applies only to the direction (the direction indicated by the arrows). Typically, such traffic lights regulate lane traffic. When only the green signal is turned on, you can continue moving to the right.
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: The hazard warning lights on a towed motor vehicle must be switched on:

answers.text: In all cases where towing is carried out

questions.comment: In all cases, when towing a towed motor vehicle, the hazard warning lights must be turned on. (Clause 7.1 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Use of hazard warning lights and warning triangles

questions.question: Is the driver of a small bus obliged to give way to a passenger car?
questions.comment: When changing lanes, the driver must give way to vehicles moving in the same direction without changing direction. The driver of a small bus moving in the left lane is the “owner” of this lane and therefore is not obliged to yield. (Clause 8.4 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Is it possible for you to make a U-turn at an intersection while driving in reverse?

answers.text: It is possible, as long as it does not interfere with other road users.

questions.comment: Reversing at intersections is prohibited. (Clause 8.12 of traffic rules)

questions.question: At what maximum speed do you have the right to continue driving outside populated areas in a truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons?

questions.question: Are you allowed to overtake in this situation?

answers.text: Permitted only if the tractor speed is less than 30 km/h

questions.comment: There is an unequal intersection in front of you. You are on the main road. The overtaking rules allow in this situation to overtake any vehicle. (Clause 11.4 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: In which of the following places can you park the bus?

questions.question: You intend to drive straight through the intersection. Who should you give way to?
