questions.question: At the entrance to the intersection, you:

answers.text: Must give way to both vehicles
Must give way only to cars
You have an advantage over both vehicles

questions.comment: If there are no priority signs at a roundabout intersection, the “right-hand rule” does not work. You are obliged to give way to all vehicles moving at such an intersection. (Clause 13.11.1 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Who do you have to give way to when turning left?
questions.comment: The intersection is unequal. Vehicles located on the main road have priority. You are on a secondary road and give way to both vehicles, regardless of the direction of their further movement. (“Road signs”, clause 13.9 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Are you allowed to stop on a motorway to the right of the line marking the edge of the roadway?

answers.text: Allowed only in case of a forced stop

questions.comment: It is prohibited to stop on the highway outside of specially designated places. (“Horizontal markings” 1.2, clauses 16.1, 16.2 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: What requirements are mandatory for organized transportation of a group of children?

answers.text: The bus must have identification signs “Transportation of Children” and a yellow or orange flashing light must be turned on.
Transportation must be carried out using seat belts
Children must be accompanied by designated chaperones

questions.comment: Organized transportation of a group of children must be carried out on a bus with all the listed requirements. questions.question: It is prohibited to operate the bus if the parking brake system does not ensure that the bus remains stationary when equipped on a slope:
questions.comment: It is prohibited to operate the bus if the parking brake system does not ensure that the bus remains stationary in the equipped state (this weight is indicated by the manufacturer) on a slope of up to 23 percent inclusive. (“List of faults”, paragraph 1.9)
topic: Malfunctions and conditions for admitting vehicles to operation

questions.question: When turning right, traffic safety is achieved by turning along the trajectory shown:

(“Driving Techniques”)

questions.question: How to determine whether a victim who has lost consciousness is breathing?

answers.text: Take the victim by the chin, tilt his head back and watch the movement of his chest for 10 seconds

Put one hand on the victim's forehead, raise the chin with two fingers and tilt your head back, bend over to his face and listen to his breathing for 10 seconds, try to feel the exhaled air with your cheek, follow the movement of the chest
Without throwing back the victim’s head, lean towards his face and listen to his breathing for 10 seconds, feel it with your cheek, follow the movement of his chest

questions.comment: Loss of consciousness in humans can occur for a variety of reasons. questions.question: Are sidewalks and shoulders part of the road?
questions.comment: “Road” is a strip of land or a surface of an artificial structure equipped or adapted and used for the movement of vehicles. The road includes one or more carriageways, as well as tram tracks, sidewalks, roadsides and dividing strips, if any. Clause 1.2, the term “Road”.

questions.question: At what distance to an uneven section of the road is this sign installed outside a populated area?

answers.text: Directly before a rough section of road

Vehicles whose actual weight per axle is more than 6 tons
Trucks with a permissible maximum weight of more than 6 tons

answers.text: Along any trajectory of the specified

answers.text: It is possible if the tractor speed is less than 30 km/h

questions.comment: Horizontal markings 1.11 are allowed to be crossed from the side of the broken line to overtake or bypass. On your part - a solid line. In such a situation, you cannot cross it. (“Horizontal markings”)

questions.question: Where should you stop?

answers.text: In front of the crossed roadway

questions.comment: Sign 6.16 “Stop line” indicates the place where vehicles stop when there is a prohibiting traffic light (traffic controller) signal. “The light is red” - you stop in front of the traffic light. (“Road signs”, paragraph 6.2 of the traffic rules)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: At what distance from the vehicle should a warning triangle be placed in this situation?
questions.comment: The action takes place in a populated area. In this case, the warning triangle is installed at a distance of at least 15 m from the vehicle. (Clause 7.2 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Use of hazard warning lights and warning triangles

questions.question: Are you allowed to make a right turn in this situation?

answers.text: Permitted if it does not interfere with vehicles moving from other directions

questions.comment: You are in the left lane, from which you cannot turn right. To turn right, it was necessary to change lanes to the right lane in advance. (Clause 8.5, 6.3 of traffic rules)

questions.question: Is it possible for you to make a U-turn along this trajectory?

answers.text: It is possible if the width of the roadway is not sufficient to perform a maneuver from the extreme left position

questions.question: Is the driver allowed to drive at too low a speed?

questions.question: Can you start overtaking in a populated area?

questions.comment: Overtaking at railway crossings and closer than 100 m in front of them is prohibited. questions.question: Where on this section of the road are you allowed to park your car for a long time?

Only after 500 m at a special site

questions.comment: Parking for the purpose of long rest, overnight stay, etc. outside a populated area is permitted only in designated areas or off roads. questions.question: Are you required to give way to a bus?

questions.question: You intend to turn left. What are your actions?

questions.question: After entering this intersection:

You will have an advantage over a car entering it
You should act by mutual agreement with the driver of the car

questions.question: Is it possible to tow a car with a non-functioning brake system if the actual weight of this car is more than half the actual weight of your car?

questions.comment: It is prohibited to tow a car with an inoperative braking system on a flexible hitch, on a rigid hitch, by partial loading - in all cases if the actual weight of the towed vehicle EXCEEDS HALF of the actual weight of your vehicle (towing). (Clause 20.4 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: When an administrative offense is committed that entails the detention of a vehicle, it is detained until:

answers.text: Drawing up a protocol on an administrative offense
Consideration of a case of an administrative offense

Before turning, reduce the speed, if necessary, engage a lower gear, and when driving through a turn, do not sharply increase the speed or brake
Any of the following actions are allowed

questions.comment: To prevent the occurrence of a skid when driving through a sharp turn, which occurs with the help of centrifugal force, it is necessary, before entering the turn, to take the correct position of the vehicle on the roadway so that the trajectory of movement in the turn passes along a larger radius of curvature, reduce the speed (by approximately 1/3), if necessary, engage a lower gear, and when driving through a turn, do not sharply increase the speed and do not brake. (Driving School of the Russian Federation, Driving Techniques)

questions.question: Is it allowed to give medications to the victim when providing first aid?
questions.comment: The correct answer is forbidden. The reason is that the victim, who may be unconscious, will have no swallowing reflex.

questions.question: Which picture shows a road with a median?

answers.text: In both pictures the road with a dividing strip is not shown

questions.comment: A dividing strip is a structurally separated element of the road. An example is the right picture. And (or) using solid marking lines 1.2 Example - left picture. The correct answer is on both. (Clause 1.2, the term “Dividing strip”)

questions.question: You are allowed to continue driving a truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons, with a trailer:
questions.comment: The plate under sign 8.4.1 “Type of vehicle” extends the effect of sign 4.1.1 “Driving straight” to trucks, including those with a trailer, with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons. You are only allowed to drive straight at the intersection. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Which of the following signs cancel all restrictions previously imposed by prohibitory signs?
questions.comment: Sign “В” - 3.31 “End of the zone of all restrictions.” (“Road signs”)

questions.question: This sign indicates that:

answers.text: You must turn right or left
Reversible traffic is organized on the road being crossed
There is one-way traffic to the right and left of the intersection

questions.comment: In front of you is an intersection, along the intersecting road of which reverse traffic is organized, as indicated by sign 5.10 “Entering a road with reverse traffic.” (“Road Signs”)

questions.question: What maneuver are you prohibited from performing with this marking line?

answers.text: All of the above maneuvers are permitted

questions.comment: In this case, a broken horizontal line 1.5 separates traffic flows. Crossing it is allowed from any direction. It does not prohibit anything when performing the listed maneuvers. On the contrary, it clearly guides you on which side of the road you are on. (“Horizontal markings”)

questions.question: The signals of such a traffic light are distributed:

answers.text: On trams, as well as other vehicles moving in the lane for route vehicles

questions.comment: To regulate the movement of trams, as well as other route vehicles moving along the lane allocated for them, single-color traffic lights with four round white-moon colored signals located in the shape of the letter “Т” can be used. (Clause 6.8 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: Are you required to turn on your turn signals in this situation?

answers.text: Obligated only if there are other vehicles at the intersection

questions.comment: According to sign 4.1.2 “Move to the right”, you can continue driving only by turning right. Before turning, you must give the appropriate warning signal. (“Road signs”, paragraph 8.1 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Who should give way?
questions.comment: There is a narrowing of the road ahead, which sign 1.20.2 “Narrowing of the road” warns drivers about. The truck driver needs to change lanes to the left. He is obliged to give way to a passenger car moving in the same direction without changing the direction of movement. (“Road signs”, clause 8.4 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: The driver accidentally drove through the intersection. Is he allowed to use reverse in this situation and then continue moving to the left?

answers.text: Permitted if it does not interfere with other road users

questions.comment: Reversing at intersections is prohibited. (Clause 8.12 of traffic rules)

questions.question: What vehicles and in what cases are allowed to drive outside populated areas at a speed of no more than 90 km/h?

answers.text: Trucks carrying people in the back
Trucks with a permissible maximum weight exceeding 3.5 tonnes on roads other than motorways
Buses carrying out organized transportation of groups of children
Buses in which the passenger seats are equipped with seat belts intended for the carriage of seated passengers exclusively, on all roads

questions.comment: Outside populated areas, buses are allowed to operate in which the seating areas for passengers are equipped with seat belts designed to transport exclusively seated passengers at a speed of no more than 90 km/h (Clause 10.3 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Can you overtake?

answers.text: Yes, if the speed of the truck is less than 30 km/h

questions.comment: Overtaking is prohibited as visibility is limited. Sometimes there is a natural desire to overtake a “barely dragging” vehicle. Do not give in to such impulses recklessly. Remember! The most dangerous are overtaking at a significantly lower speed of the overtaken vehicle compared to the speed of the oncoming vehicle. (Clause 11.4 of the traffic regulations) The main condition for overtaking is “The distance required for overtaking should never exceed half the visible distance of the path.” That is, if your overtaking path is 200 m, then the visibility of the road should be at least 400 m. Strictly adhere to this rule, otherwise you will find yourself in a situation - a “trap” from which there is no way out.

questions.question: Is stopping at this place allowed?

answers.text: Allowed if the distance between the vehicle and the continuous marking line is at least 3 m

questions.comment: Stopping at pedestrian crossings and at a distance closer than 5 m is prohibited. This distance is not maintained. You cannot stop at the designated place. (Clause 12.4 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: The meanings of which road signs are canceled by traffic lights?
questions.comment: Traffic is regulated by: traffic controllers, traffic signals, priority signs, markings, road surfaces, and the “right-hand rule.” According to the above-mentioned “principle of priority for traffic regulation,” priority signs work (i.e., we are guided by them) in the case when there is no traffic controller, the traffic light is turned off, faulty, or switched to “yellow flashing mode.” (“Road Signs”, paragraphs 6.15 and 13.3 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: When turning right you must give way to:
questions.comment: When turning right or left, the driver is obliged to give way to pedestrians and cyclists crossing the roadway on which he is turning. This rule for driving through intersections applies to both controlled and unregulated intersections. (Clause 13.1 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: You intend to turn left. Who do you have to give way to?
questions.comment: The intersection is unequal. Vehicles on the main road have priority. They are guided by the “right hand rule” among themselves. After they pass, following the same rule, vehicles on the secondary road will pass. The passenger car passes the intersection first, you are the second, the motorcyclist is the third, the bus is the last. (Clause 13.9, 13.10, 13.11 Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: What should you do in this situation?

answers.text: Drive through a railway crossing without stopping at the sign
Stop in front of the sign and continue driving immediately after the train passes
Stop in front of the sign and continue driving, making sure there is no approaching train

questions.comment: There is a multi-track railway on the route. You need to stop in front of sign 2.5 “Non-stop traffic is prohibited”, wait for the train to pass and, after making sure that there are no approaching trains from both directions, continue further movement. (“Road signs”, paragraphs 15.1, 15.2, 15.3, 15.4 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: To attract the attention of the driver of an overtaken vehicle when driving in a populated area during daylight hours, you can:

answers.text: Only by briefly switching the headlights from low beam to high beam
Only by combined sound and light signals

questions.comment: The use of a sound signal when overtaking is allowed only outside populated areas. In a populated area, to warn about overtaking, instead of a sound signal, a light signal may be given, which is a short-term switching of headlights from low beam to high beam. (Clause 19.11 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Use of external lighting fixtures and audible signals

questions.question: In what cases is it prohibited to operate a vehicle?

answers.text: Fuel level indicator does not work
The ignition timing adjustment is broken
The audible warning device is faulty

questions.comment: The “List of faults” prohibits operation if the sound signal does not work. (“List of faults” clause 9.3)
topic: Malfunctions and conditions for admitting vehicles to operation

questions.question: How does the braking distance of a vehicle depend on its speed?

answers.text: Increases with the square of the speed

questions.comment: The magnitude of the braking distance depends on the square of the speed. Thus, when the speed is doubled, the braking distance will increase four times, and when the speed increases three times, the braking distance will increase nine times. (“Driving technology”)

questions.question: How to stop bleeding when a vein and small arteries are injured?

answers.text: Apply a pressure bandage to the wound site
Apply a tourniquet above the wound site
Apply a tourniquet below the wound site

questions.comment: It is necessary to apply a pressure bandage directly to the wound. (“Medical assistance in case of an accident”)

questions.question: Leaving the yard or other adjacent territory:

answers.text: Considered a crossroads of equal roads
Considered a crossroads of unequal roads

questions.comment: “Adjacent territory” is the territory directly adjacent to the road and not intended for through traffic of vehicles (yards, residential areas, parking lots, gas stations, enterprises, etc.). Leaving the yard or other adjacent territory is not considered an intersection. (Clause 1.2 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Which of the following signs require a mandatory stop?
questions.comment: Only sign “Б” - 2.5 “Moving without stopping is prohibited” - requires a mandatory stop. The sign is installed either at the intersection of roadways (case 1) or at the railway station. crossing, or quarantine post (case 2). Sign “А” - 2.6 “Right of way for oncoming traffic” - prohibits entry onto a narrow section of the road if this may impede oncoming traffic. Sign “В” - 6.16 “Stop line” - indicates the place where vehicles stop when there is a prohibiting traffic light. Sign “Г” - 2.4 “Give way” - determines the order of priority passing a specific intersection. If necessary, choose a stopping place yourself, guided by the rule: “You must not resume or continue driving, or perform any maneuver if the action of your car forces other road users to change direction or speed.” (“Road Signs”)

questions.question: In the area covered by this sign, it is permitted to use a sound signal:

answers.text: Only to prevent a traffic accident
In both of the above cases

questions.comment: In the area covered by sign 3.26 “Sound Signal Prohibited,” sound signaling is prohibited, except in cases of warning of a traffic accident. (“Road Signs”)

questions.question: Where do the requirements of the Rules relating to populated areas begin to apply?

answers.text: Only from the place where the “Beginning of a settlement” road sign was installed on a white background
From the installation site of a road sign with the name of the locality on a white or blue background
At the beginning of the built-up area immediately adjacent to the road

questions.comment: Only from the place of installation of sign 5.23.1 or 5.23.2 “Beginning of a populated area” on a white background. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: This vertical marking marks the side surfaces of the fences:

answers.text: Only on dangerous sections of roads
Only on sections of roads that are not considered dangerous

questions.comment: Vertical markings 2.6 indicate the side surfaces of fences in all cases when markings 2.5 are not used, used on curved roads, steep slopes, and other dangerous areas.

questions.question: What do a red flashing signal or two alternately flashing red lights mean at a railway crossing?

answers.text: Movement is permitted with extreme caution

questions.comment: A red flashing signal or two alternately flashing red signals prohibit movement. Flashing red signals are used at railway crossings, in front of drawbridges, ferries or crossings and in places where firefighters and other emergency vehicles leave. (Clause 6.2 of the Traffic Regulations. Commentary on the Traffic Regulations of the Russian Federation, publishing house "Za Rulem")
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: What light signals are you required to give in this situation?

answers.text: Turn on the left turn indicator lights
Briefly switch the headlights from low to high beam
Apply the listed light signals at the same time

questions.comment: You change lanes to the left. Timely activation of the left turn signal is mandatory in any case. (Clause 8.1 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: In what directions can you continue driving in the second lane?
questions.comment: Sign 4.1.6 “Moving right or left” from the leftmost lane allows you to turn left and turn around to move in the opposite direction. To turn right, it was necessary to change lanes to the far right lane in advance. (“Road signs”, clause 8.5 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Are you allowed to make a U-turn in this place?

answers.text: Permitted if it does not interfere with the movement of route vehicles

questions.comment: Turning around at stops for route vehicles is prohibited. (Clause 8.11 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Which trajectory do you have the right to continue?
questions.comment: Drivers turning onto a road marked with sign 5.10 “Entering a road with reverse traffic” must drive in the far right lane. In this situation, along trajectory “Б”. Changing lanes is permitted only after the driver is convinced that traffic in this direction is also permitted in other lanes. (Clause 9.8 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Location of vehicles on the roadway

questions.question: Is overtaking allowed at intersections?

answers.text: Permitted only when driving on the main road at uncontrolled intersections

questions.comment: Overtaking is prohibited at signalized intersections, as well as at uncontrolled intersections when driving on a road that is not the main one. (Clause 11.4 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: The drivers of which vehicles violated the stopping rules?

answers.text: Small bus Б and truck В

questions.comment: Stopping and parking of vehicles if there is a shoulder should be carried out on it (as the driver of car “А” did). And only in its absence - at the edge of the roadway. Drivers of cars “Б” and “В” are violators of traffic rules. (Clause 12.1 of traffic rules)

questions.question: You intend to turn left. What are your actions?

answers.text: Stop in front of the intersection, wait for the green traffic light on the median, and begin the maneuver
Having arrived at the intersection, stop at the stop line and, after waiting for the green signal of the traffic light installed on the dividing strip, complete the maneuver
Perform a maneuver without stopping at an intersection

questions.comment: In a normal situation, the driver leaves the intersection regardless of the traffic light signals at the exit from the intersection. But here the situation is different. Separate traffic lights are used. There are two intersections of roadways at the intersection. When turning left, you are required to stop at the stop line (marking 1.12) when the traffic light is prohibiting. After turning on the permitting signal, continue driving through the intersection. (Clause 13.7 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Who should you give way to when turning left?
questions.comment: The intersection is equal. Regardless of its configuration, drivers are guided by the “right-hand rule.” The truck passes first, since there is no obstacle on the right, the passenger car is second, and you are the last. You should give way to both vehicles. (Clause 13.11 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: When driving straight, you must give way:
questions.comment: The intersection is unequal. The main road changes direction. Vehicles located on the main road have priority. After they pass, vehicles on the secondary road pass, which are guided by the “right-hand rule” among themselves, i.e. whoever has an obstacle on the right concedes. There is an obstacle on the right side of the motorcyclist, he is giving way to you. Vehicles will pass the intersection in the following order: bus, car, you, motorcyclist. (“Road signs”, paragraphs 13.9, 13.10 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Where should you stop if there is a traffic jam just beyond the pedestrian crossing?

answers.text: At a pedestrian crossing, if there are no pedestrians
No closer than 5 m to the pedestrian crossing

questions.comment: Here you are making a temporary cessation of movement, and not a deliberate stop. Therefore, you stop before the border of the pedestrian crossing, which is indicated by signs or markings. The correct answer is immediately before the pedestrian crossing. (Clause 14.4 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Pedestrian crossings and stops of fixed-route vehicles

questions.question: Which picture shows a car whose driver violates the rules for transporting goods?
questions.comment: The rules allow the movement of vehicles, the overall parameters of which do not exceed 2.55 meters in width. Transportation of cargo protruding laterally not more than 0.4 m from the outer edge of the side light is allowed without the identification mark "Oversized cargo". In Figure "А", this distance is greater than the permissible one. In Figure "Б", the distance is less than the permissible distance. Only the driver of the car "А" violates the Rules.(Clauses 23.4, 23.5 of the SDA)

questions.question: In what cases is the operation of vehicles prohibited?

answers.text: The engine does not develop maximum power
The engine is unstable at idle
Power supply and exhaust systems are incomplete and leaky

questions.comment: In the event of a malfunction of the engine power supply and exhaust gas systems and their incompleteness and leaks, the operation of the vehicle is prohibited (“List of faults”, paragraph 8.2).
topic: Malfunctions and conditions for admitting vehicles to operation

questions.question: Reducing the braking distance of a vehicle not equipped with an anti-lock braking system is achieved by:

answers.text: By pressing the brake pedal all the way
By intermittently pressing the brake pedal
By pressing the brake pedal while simultaneously using the parking brake system

questions.comment: Wheel locking when braking on a wet, slippery surface causes skidding - uncontrollability of the car. Therefore, to reduce the braking distance and ensure traffic safety, use pulsating, intermittent pressure on the brake pedal and releasing it alternately.

questions.question: The minimum required distance when driving on a dry road in a truck or bus is considered to be the distance that the vehicle will cover in no less than:
questions.comment: The distance between moving vehicles depends on their braking distance. The braking distance of a truck or bus under equal conditions is significantly longer than a passenger car. The reason for this is the large mass and longer response time of the brake mechanisms. Therefore, the necessary safe distance is considered to be the distance that cars of these classes will travel, in contrast to passenger cars, in 3 seconds.

questions.question: If, as a result of a road traffic accident (RTA), damage was caused only to property, then, having previously recorded the position of vehicles in relation to each other and road infrastructure objects, traces and objects related to the accident, damage to vehicles, the driver involved in the accident:

answers.text: Obliged to clear the roadway if the movement of other vehicles is obstructed
Has the right to vacate the roadway at his own discretion

questions.comment: According to clause 2.6.1 of the traffic rules, if as a result of an accident damage is caused only to property, then, having previously recorded the position of the vehicle in relation to each other and road infrastructure, traces and objects related to the accident, damage to the vehicle, the driver involved in the accident is obliged to clear the roadway if an obstacle is created to the movement of other vehicles. (December 14, 2018: the question and answer options have been updated. Now the essence of the question is under what conditions the driver can clear the roadway part)

questions.question: Which of the following signs are used to indicate the boundaries of an artificial roughness?
questions.comment: Sign “А” - 5.20 “Artificial hump” indicates the boundary of an artificial hump (“speed bump”). The sign is installed at the nearest boundary of the artificial bump relative to approaching vehicles. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: This sign prohibits the movement of vehicles that:

answers.text: Have a permissible maximum weight of more than 7 tons
Have an actual mass of more than 7 tons
Transport cargo weighing more than 7 tons

questions.comment: Sign 3.11 “Weight limit” prohibits the movement of vehicles, including trains, the actual weight of which is greater than indicated on the sign. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: By driving what kind of vehicle can you outrun a passenger car?

answers.text: Only by truck with a permissible maximum weight of not more than 3.5 tons

questions.comment: Sign 5.15.7 “Direction of traffic along lanes” shows sign 3.4 “Truck traffic is prohibited” without a number on the vehicle. In this case, this sign prohibits the movement of trucks with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons in the left lane in the direction of your movement. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: What does this markup mean?

answers.text: Recommended speed for this section of the road
Permitted maximum speed on this section of the road

questions.comment: Marking 1.24.2 duplicates sign 3.24 “Maximum speed limit” and is used in conjunction with it. (“Horizontal markings”, “Road signs”)

questions.question: What should road users follow if the traffic controller’s instructions contradict the meanings of traffic lights and the requirements of road signs?
questions.comment: Traffic regulation is based on the “principle of traffic regulation priority”. If there are several controls, only one is effective. In descending order, traffic is regulated by: a traffic controller, traffic signals, priority signs, markings, road surface, and the “right-hand rule.” Based on this principle, if there is a traffic controller, follow his signals and instructions. (Traffic rules 6.15, 8.9, 13.3, 1.2 term “Main Road”)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: This hand signal, given by a motorcycle driver moving in the left lane, communicates his intention:
questions.comment: Both hand signals inform about the motorcyclists’ intention to make a right turn. (Clause 8.1 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: When changing to the right lane in this situation, you:

answers.text: Must give way to a car moving in the adjacent lane
You have an advantage in movement

questions.comment: The lane you are moving on ends. You need to rebuild. When rebuilding, you are obliged to give way to vehicles moving in the same direction without changing the direction of movement.("Horizontal marking" 1.19, clause 8.4 of the SDA)

questions.question: On what trajectory are you allowed to make a U-turn?

answers.text: U-turn is prohibited along the specified trajectories

questions.comment: The effect of sign 4.1.1 “Move straight”, installed before the intersection of roadways, extends to the first intersection behind the sign. At this intersection there are two intersections formed by a dividing strip. Trajectory “Б” passes through the first intersection, which contradicts the actions of the sign. You can make a U-turn along trajectory “А”. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: What are your actions in this situation?

answers.text: Pass a truck on the right side of the road
Continue driving only after the truck has cleared the lane.

questions.comment: A truck driver gives a turn signal. Passing on the right in this situation is allowed if you make a detour without going onto the side of the road, on which traffic is prohibited. In this situation, wait until the truck clears the lane. (Section 9.9 of the Traffic Rules)
topic: Location of vehicles on the roadway

questions.question: Is overtaking on a hill prohibited?

answers.text: Prohibited only at the end of the climb

questions.comment: The end of the rise is the point where the longitudinal profile of the road breaks. There is no visibility when approaching this place. Therefore, the Rules prohibit overtaking at the end of a climb, on dangerous turns and in other areas with limited visibility. (Clause 11.4 of the Traffic Regulations) Do not forget the main condition for overtaking - “The path required for overtaking should never exceed half of the visible segment of the path.”

questions.question: Did the truck driver violate the parking rules?

answers.text: Violated only if the permissible maximum weight of the truck is more than 3.5 tons

questions.comment: Trucks are prohibited from stopping or parking on the adjacent sidewalk. (Clause 12.2 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: What should you do when turning right?

answers.text: Stop and wait for another signal from the traffic controller
Pass the intersection, giving way to the tram

questions.comment: The intersection is adjustable. On the left side, with this gesture of the adjuster, trackless vehicles are allowed to move in all directions. Trams move only "in the direction of the regulator's hands". In this situation, the tram cannot continue to move. His driver will wait for the regulator signal to change. You continue moving through the intersection, i.e. you pass it first.(Clause 6.10 of the Traffic Rules)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: What should you do when driving through a roundabout?

answers.text: Act by mutual agreement with the truck driver

questions.comment: When entering an intersection with a roundabout, in the absence of priority signs, indicated only by sign 4.3 “Roundabout”, the “right hand” rule DOES NOT WORK. You have the right of way and go through the intersection first. When entering this intersection, the driver of a truck is obliged to give way to ALL vehicles moving along such an intersection. (Clause 13.11.1 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Who do you have to give way to when turning left?
questions.comment: The intersection is unequal. The main road changes direction. Vehicles located on the main road have priority. After they pass, vehicles on the secondary road pass, which are guided by the “right-hand rule” among themselves, i.e. whoever has an obstacle on the right concedes. There is an obstacle on the right side of the motorcyclist, he is giving way to you. Vehicles will pass the intersection in the following order: bus, car, you, motorcyclist. (“Road signs”, paragraphs 13.9, 13.10 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: At what minimum distance to the nearest rail should you stop?
questions.comment: In the absence of a barrier, the driver must stop no closer than 10 m to the nearest rail. (Clause 15.4 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: When towing on a flexible coupling, a distance must be provided between the towing and towed vehicles:
questions.comment: When towing on a flexible hitch, the distance between the towing and towed vehicles must be within 4 - 6 m.(Clause 20.3 of the SDA)

questions.question: What administrative offenses committed by a driver who is deprived of the right to drive vehicles entail administrative arrest?

answers.text: Driving; Leaving by the driver, in violation of the Rules, the scene of a traffic accident in which he was a participant
Driving while intoxicated; failure to comply with the legal requirement of an authorized official to undergo a medical examination for intoxication

questions.comment: Administrative arrest of drivers for all of the listed actions is provided for by the articles of the Code of Administrative Offenses: Art. 12.7, Part 2; Art. 12.26 p.2; Art. 12.27. Part 2.

questions.question: Eliminating rear axle skidding by increasing speed is possible:

answers.text: Only on front wheel drive vehicle
Only on rear wheel drive car
On any of the listed vehicles

questions.comment: A front-wheel drive car differs not only in its layout, but also in its behavior on the road. When driving in a straight line, it does not experience the slightest tendency to skid. Skidding occurs when cornering due to centrifugal forces. If the driver of a rear-wheel drive car in this situation reduces the speed and turns the steering wheel in the direction of the skid, then the driver of a front-wheel drive car should under no circumstances do this. If the fuel supply decreases, engine braking occurs, then, due to inertial forces, there is a “peck” forward, which unloads the rear wheels, and on the contrary, in order to restore traction with the road, they just need the additional load that occurs when the speed increases.

questions.question: Which picture shows the correct position of your hands on the steering wheel?
questions.comment: The most rational position is the position of the hands on the steering wheel when compared with the clock dial “ten to two”. The correct answer is in the right picture. (“Driving technique”)

questions.question: Is the driver obliged to provide a vehicle to medical and pharmaceutical workers to transport citizens to the nearest medical facility in cases that threaten their lives?

answers.text: Required only when moving in the same direction

questions.comment: Paragraph 2.3.3 of the Traffic Regulations obliges medical and pharmaceutical workers to provide such a transport service.

questions.question: You can continue moving:

answers.text: Along any trajectory of the specified

questions.comment: Dividing strips divide the road into adjacent carriageways. The effect of sign 4.1.2 “Move to the right”, installed before the intersection of roadways, extends to the first intersection. You can continue driving only along trajectory “А”. (Clause 1.2 term “Dividing strip”, “Road signs”)

questions.question: Is it possible for this road train to cross the bridge if the actual weight of the vehicle is 8 tons and the trailer is 5 tons?

answers.text: Possible only with permission from the State Traffic Inspectorate

questions.comment: Sign 3.11 “Weight limit” prohibits the movement of vehicles, including trains, the actual weight of which is greater than that indicated on the sign. The actual weight of the road train is 13 tons. The driver must go around this section of the road along a different route. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Which of the following signs are used to indicate the number assigned to the road (route)?
questions.comment: Signs “А” and “Б” have a common number and name: 6.14.1 “Route number”. Sign “В” - 6.13 “Kilometer sign” - indicates the distance to the beginning or end of the road (km). (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Temporary horizontal markings have:
questions.comment: Temporary horizontal markings are orange. (“Road markings”)

questions.question: You have the right to move:
questions.comment: The intersection is controlled. From the left and right sides of the traffic controller, trackless vehicles are allowed to move straight or to the right. According to the sign 5.7.1 “Exit to a one-way road”, one-way traffic is carried out on the road being crossed. This sign only prohibits turning left. (“Road signs”, clause 6.10 of the traffic rules)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: How should you mark your vehicle in the event of a traffic accident?

answers.text: In both of the above ways

questions.comment: In case of an accident, the driver is obliged to turn on the emergency alarm and set an emergency stop sign.(Clauses 7.1, 7.2 of traffic rules)
topic: Use of hazard warning lights and warning triangles

questions.question: Who has the advantage in movement?
questions.comment: The driver of a car leaves the adjacent territory to the road (from a gas station). He is obliged to give way to vehicles moving along the road being crossed; accordingly, the truck driver has “advantage.” (Clause 1.2, 8.3 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Is the driver allowed to reverse to pick up a passenger on this section of the road?

answers.text: Allowed if the driver is driving a route vehicle

questions.comment: Sign 4.1.1 “Move straight” does not prohibit reversing if it occurs outside the boundaries of the intersection. In this section, you can drive up to the passenger in reverse, subject to the conditions stated above. (“Road signs”, paragraph 8.12 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Are you allowed, while driving a truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons, to enter the third lane in this situation?

answers.text: Permitted only for left turns or U-turns

questions.comment: The driver of a truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 2.5 tons can drive into the leftmost lane if there are three or more lanes in a given direction only to turn left and make a U-turn. (Clause 9.4 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Location of vehicles on the roadway

questions.question: Is it possible for you to overtake a tractor while driving a truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons?

answers.text: It is possible if the tractor speed is less than 30 km/h

questions.comment: On this vehicle, within the coverage area of sign 3.22 “Overtaking of trucks is prohibited” - overtaking of all vehicles is prohibited, without exception. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Where are you allowed to stop?
questions.comment: On a road that has one lane in each direction and does not have tram tracks in the middle, in a populated area marked with signs 5.23.1 and 5.23.2 “Beginning of a populated area” (with a white background), stopping and parking is allowed not only on the right side, but also on the left side of the road. (“Road signs”, paragraph 12.1 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Who do you have to give way to when turning left?
questions.comment: The intersection is adjustable. The tram in equivalent conditions has an advantage over trackless vehicles. Along with it, at the same time, since the trajectories do not intersect, a passenger car will pass, turning to the right, to which you must also give way when turning to the left. You will be the last to cross the intersection.(Clauses 13.3, 13.4, 13.6 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: You must give way to a truck:

answers.text: In both of the above cases

questions.comment: The intersection is equal. Drivers are guided by the “right hand rule”. You will have an obstacle on the right only when driving straight - you are giving way to a truck. When turning right, there is no obstacle on the right. (Clause 13.11 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: You intend to turn around. Who do you need to give way to?
questions.comment: The intersection is unequal. The main road changes direction. Vehicles located on the main road have priority over others, regardless of their further direction of travel. They are guided by the “right hand rule” among themselves. The truck passes first, you pass after it, the passenger car passes last. (Clause 13.9, 13.10, 13.11 Traffic Rules)

questions.question: Where are you allowed to stop when driving on the motorway?

answers.text: Any place to the right of the line marking the edge of the roadway
Any place at the edge of the roadway

questions.comment: On the highway, it is prohibited to stop outside special parking areas marked with signs 6.4 “Parking (parking space)” or 7.11 “Rest place” (shown in the figure). At the same time, the distance to the designated place is 500 m. (“Road signs”, clause 16.1 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: While driving in the dark outside a populated area with your high beam headlights on, you caught up with a vehicle moving ahead. What are your actions?

answers.text: Leave the side lights on and turn off the high beams
Switch the high beam headlights to low beam

questions.comment: To eliminate the possibility of dazzling the overtaken driver through the rear-view mirrors, it is necessary to switch the high beam to the low beam. (Clause 19.2 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Use of external lighting fixtures and audible signals

questions.question: What should a driver do if the windshield washer fails while driving?

answers.text: Continue your intended trip with extreme caution
Attempt to rectify the fault on site, and if this is not possible, then proceed to the place of parking or repair with the necessary precautions

questions.comment: Clause 3 of the “Basic Provisions” prohibits the operation of a vehicle with malfunctions in the part related to road safety. Clause 2.3.1 of the Traffic Regulations does not prohibit further movement with such a malfunction to the parking or repair site in compliance with safety precautions.
topic: Malfunctions and conditions for admitting vehicles to operation

questions.question: What should you do if the rear axle of a rear-wheel drive car skids while turning?

answers.text: Increase the fuel supply, stabilize the movement with the steering wheel
Slow down and turn the steering wheel in the direction of skidding
Significantly reduce fuel delivery without changing the steering wheel position
Slightly reduce the fuel supply and turn the steering wheel in the direction of skidding

questions.comment: Don't get lost in such a situation. Do not suddenly reduce the fuel supply. Reduce engine speed as smoothly as possible; To level out the skid, turn the steering wheel in the direction of the skid.

questions.question: In what case does the driver need to assess the situation behind him?

answers.text: Before performing a maneuver (changing lanes or changing direction)
In all of the above cases

questions.comment: Before performing any maneuver, you should assess the situation behind you. In the above cases too. Typically this is done through the rear view mirrors. Keep in mind that they have “dead” (unvisible) zones. Therefore, it is advisable to avoid sudden maneuvers.

questions.question: What does it mean to give way?

answers.text: You must stop only if there is a "Give Way" sign.
You must stop to let other road users pass
You must not start, resume or continue driving, or perform any maneuver if this may force other road users who have priority over you to change direction or speed.

questions.comment: Give way (do not interfere) means that you must not start, resume or continue driving, or perform any maneuver if this may force other road users who have priority over you to change direction or speed. (Clause 1.2 term “Give way”)

questions.question: Which of the following signs provide the right of way at uncontrolled intersections?
questions.comment: Signs: 2.1 “Main Road” (“А”) and 2.3.5 “Adjunction of a Secondary Road” (“В”) provide the right of way at uncontrolled intersections to vehicles located on the main road. (Clause 1.2 term “Main Road”, 13.9 Traffic Rules)

questions.question: Are you allowed to overtake if you are driving a truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons?

answers.text: Allowed if the speed of the overtaken vehicle is no more than 30 km/h

questions.comment: On this vehicle, within the coverage area of sign 3.22 “Overtaking of trucks is prohibited” - overtaking of all vehicles is prohibited, without exception. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Is it possible for the driver to park the truck in this location using the specified method?

answers.text: It is possible if the permissible maximum weight of the vehicle is no more than 7.5 tons

questions.comment: Drivers of trucks who have a sign 6.4 “Parking (parking space)” with one of the signs 8.6.2 - 8.6.9 “Method of parking vehicles” are not allowed to stand in the coverage area of this sign. It is not allowed for any trucks to park on the edge of the sidewalk and clause 12.2 of the traffic rules and in other places not marked with signs. Therefore, the answer is clear - the truck driver is violating the Rules. (“Road Signs”)

questions.question: This vertical marking indicates:

answers.text: Only the lower edge of the span of tunnels, bridges and overpasses
Any elements of road structures that pose a danger

questions.comment: Vertical markings 2.2 indicate the lower edge of the superstructure of tunnels, bridges and overpasses. (“Vertical markings”)

questions.question: Where should you stop?
questions.comment: If there is a stop line (marking 1.12) at a prohibitory traffic light signal, you should stop in front of the stop line. (“Horizontal markings”, paragraph 6.13 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: Should drivers use their turn signals when maneuvering in a parking lot or gas station?

answers.text: Yes, but only if there are other vehicles nearby.

questions.comment: Always inform other road users of your intentions. It doesn’t matter where, under what conditions, under what circumstances you are a driver. Before starting maneuvering, you should turn on the appropriate turn signal. (Clause 8.1 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: You are permitted to make a right turn in a long vehicle:

answers.text: Along any trajectory of the specified

questions.comment: If the vehicle, due to its size or for other reasons, cannot make a turn from the extreme position without violating paragraph 8.5 of the traffic rules, it is allowed to deviate from these requirements. In this case, the turn must also be carried out in such a way that when leaving the intersection of roadways, the vehicle does not end up on the side of oncoming traffic. (Clause 8.6, 8.7 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Is the driver allowed to reverse when there are no other road users?

answers.text: Allowed only up to the pedestrian crossing

questions.comment: Reversing on sections of roads marked with sign 5.5 “One-way road” is not prohibited. Therefore, you can perform the maneuver before the pedestrian crossing, since reversing is prohibited on them. (“Road signs”, paragraph 8.12 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Is it possible for you to enter the leftmost lane in this situation?

answers.text: It is possible if the horse-drawn cart moves at a speed of no more than 30 km/h

questions.comment: It is prohibited to enter the leftmost lane intended for oncoming traffic on a two-way road with three lanes. (Clause 9.3 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Location of vehicles on the roadway

questions.question: Are you allowed to overtake?

answers.text: It is allowed if it does not interfere with other traffic participants.

questions.comment: The intersection is equal. Overtaking is prohibited at equivalent intersections. (Clause 11.4 of traffic regulations)

questions.question: Which driver violated the stopping rules?

answers.text: Only the driver of car А
Only the driver of car Б

questions.comment: Don't confuse stopping with parking. Stopping is prohibited directly at a railway crossing, the boundaries of which are barriers. Parking is prohibited directly at the railway crossing and closer than 50 m from it. Drivers stopped outside the railway crossing without violating the rules. (Clause 12.4, 12.1 of traffic rules)

questions.question: During which maneuver does a truck driver have the right of way?

answers.text: When performing any of the listed maneuvers

questions.comment: A truck driver driving under the illuminated green arrow in the additional section, which is illuminated simultaneously with the main green signal, can turn left and make a U-turn. In this case, moving under the illuminated green arrow, in an additional section, which is switched on simultaneously with the main red signal, a bus and a passenger car are required to give way to all other vehicles moving from all other directions. The driver of a truck has an advantage in this situation when performing any of the listed maneuvers. (Clause 13.5 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: You intend to turn left. What are your actions?

answers.text: Give way to the tram by turning from the left lane
Let the tram pass, change lanes onto tram tracks in the same direction, and then make a turn

questions.comment: You and the tram are in equal conditions. In this case, the tram has an advantage over trackless vehicles. Give way to the tram. (Clause 13.11 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: To whom do you have to give way when driving in a forward direction?
questions.comment: The intersection is unequal. The main road changes direction. Vehicles located on the main road have priority. Between themselves they are guided by the “right hand rule”, i.e. whoever has an obstacle on the right concedes. You are on a secondary road - you give way to both vehicles. (“Road signs” 2.4, 8.13, clauses 13.9, 13.10 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Is it possible for you, driving a truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons, to get ahead in this situation?

answers.text: It is possible if the permissible maximum weight of the vehicle is no more than 7.5 tons

questions.comment: On any roads that have three or more lanes for traffic in a given direction, the leftmost lane is allowed to occupy only during heavy traffic, when other lanes are occupied, as well as for turning left or making a U-turn, and trucks with r.m.m. more than 2.5 tons - only for turning left or turning. Carry out an advance on a truck if the r.m.m. a truck weighing more than 3.5 tons is prohibited. (Clause 9.4 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Location of vehicles on the roadway

questions.question: When driving during daylight hours, the vehicle must have the following on:
questions.comment: During daylight hours, low-beam headlights or daytime running lights must be turned on on all moving vehicles for the purpose of identifying them. Instead of low beams for this purpose, it is allowed to use fog lights. The correct answer is any of the above. (Clause 19.4, 19.5 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Use of external lighting fixtures and audible signals

questions.question: It is prohibited to operate a truck and road train if the parking brake system does not ensure that the vehicle remains stationary when in running order on a slope:
questions.comment: It is prohibited to operate a truck and road train if the parking brake system does not ensure the stationary state of the vehicle in running order on a slope of up to 31% inclusive. (“List of faults”, paragraph 1.9)
topic: Malfunctions and conditions for admitting vehicles to operation

questions.question: What should be done to quickly restore the effectiveness of a vehicle's brakes after driving through a water obstacle?

answers.text: Press the brake pedal sharply and then continue driving.
Continue driving and dry the brake pads by repeatedly pressing the brake pedal briefly.
Continue driving at low speed without braking

questions.comment: Some drivers do not attach importance to carrying out such an operation, which leads to collisions with obstacles, etc., since the effectiveness of “raw brakes” is sharply reduced, especially if the brake mechanisms are of the drum type. Dry the brakes by briefly pressing the brakes, after shifting to a lower gear.

questions.question: What are the initial steps to take when providing first aid in the event of an injury resulting from a road accident?

answers.text: Wash the wound with water, remove foreign bodies embedded in the wound, apply sterile cotton wool, securing it with a bandage.
Put on medical gloves, wash the wound with an alcohol solution of iodine, lubricate it with medicinal ointment and seal it with a continuous adhesive plaster
Wear medical gloves, do not wash the wound, apply a sterile gauze napkin to the wound, securing it with an adhesive plaster around the edges or a bandage.

questions.comment: To avoid infection with infections transmitted from the victim through blood, when providing first aid, it is initially necessary to wear medical gloves, do not wash the wound, apply a sterile gauze cloth to it, securing it with an adhesive plaster around the edges or a bandage. It is impossible to seal the wound with a continuous adhesive plaster (seal it), as this will lead to subsequent complications.

questions.question: Which picture shows an intersection?
questions.comment: An intersection is a place where roads cross, join or branch at the same level. The left picture shows an unequal intersection. Exits from adjacent territories are not considered intersections. Example - right picture. (Clause 1.2 of traffic rules)

questions.question: You can make a U-turn:

answers.text: Along any trajectory of the specified

questions.comment: The effect of the sign 4.1.1 “Go straight”, if installed before the intersection of roadways, applies only to the first intersection behind the sign. You can make a U-turn along trajectory “Б”. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Are you allowed to park your car in this place on odd days of the month?
questions.comment: The action takes place in a populated area, on a road with one lane in each direction, without tram tracks in the middle. On such a road you can stop and park not only on the right side of the road, but also on the left, if there are no prohibiting signs. In this situation, the following signs were used simultaneously: on the right side 3.29 “Parking is prohibited on odd days of the month”, on the left side 3.30 “Parking is prohibited on even days of the month.” When parking a car in this case, please note that from 21.00 to 24.00 these signs are not valid due to the rearrangement of vehicles. Therefore, in this place the car can be parked from 21.00 on an odd day to 24.00 on an even number. The correct answer is the second. Allowed only after 21.00. (“Road signs”, clause 12.1 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Which of the following signs indicate areas where the driver is required to give way to pedestrians on the roadway?
questions.comment: Signs: “Б” - 5.19.2 “Pedestrian crossing”, “В” - 5.21 “Residential zone” give priority to pedestrians on the roadway on sections of roads and territories designated by them. Warning sign “А” - 1.22 “Pedestrian crossing” warns of approaching a pedestrian crossing marked with signs 5.19.1, 5.19.2 and (or) markings 1.14.1 and 1.14.2. Installed in a populated area 50-100 m ahead, outside a populated area 150-300 m ahead. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: What does the А 100 marking on the roadway mean?
questions.comment: “Horizontal markings” 1.22 indicate the road number.

questions.question: You can continue moving:
questions.comment: The traffic controller in this situation uses a standard signal - arms down (“Chest, back - wall”). Trackless vehicles are allowed to move from the right and left sides - straight and to the right (clause 6.10). According to lane markings 1.18, you can only turn right. But the correct answer is “Straight and to the right”, referring to paragraph 6.15 of the Traffic Regulations: “Drivers and pedestrians must comply with the requirements of the signals and orders of the traffic controller, even if they contradict the traffic light signals, the requirements of road signs or markings.”
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: What should you do when making a left turn on a two-lane road?

answers.text: Start the maneuver while simultaneously turning on the left turn indicators
Turn on the left turn indicators, then proceed with the maneuver
Make sure it is safe to perform the maneuver, then turn on the left turn indicators and begin the maneuver.

questions.comment: On any road, when turning left or making a U-turn, as required by paragraph 8.1 of the traffic rules, turn on the left turn signal in advance. But since in the situation under consideration there is one lane in each direction, one of the drivers moving behind you in the same direction, already ahead of you, may give a signal and begin overtaking. In this case, according to clause 11.3 of the traffic rules, you will create an obstacle to him by your actions, being an unconscious violator of the traffic rules. Therefore, on such a road, if there is traffic, smoothly reduce the speed in advance, while practically not braking, lightly pressing the brake pedal several times, and turn on the brake lights; at this time, make sure that no one is overtaking, turn on the left turn signal and, once again making sure that further intentions to turn left or make a U-turn are clear to other drivers, proceed to perform the maneuver, taking into account oncoming traffic. (Paragraphs 8.1, 11.1 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: You intend to start moving from the sidewalk. Should you give way to a motorcycle making a U-turn?

answers.text: No, if you are driving a route vehicle.

questions.comment: Before driving, the driver must make sure that the maneuver will be safe and will not interfere with other road users. (Clause 8.1 of the Traffic Regulations). According to this clause, you give way to a motorcyclist, regardless of what vehicle you are driving.

questions.question: Is the driver of a small bus allowed to drive in reverse to pick up a passenger in a tunnel?

answers.text: Permitted if it does not interfere with other traffic participants

questions.comment: Reversing is prohibited in tunnels. In this case, regardless of the presence of lighting in the tunnel, the lighting devices on the vehicle must be turned on. The actions of this driver should be regarded as dangerous. (Clause 8.11, 8.12 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Are you allowed to drive a truck in this lane?

answers.text: Permitted if the permissible maximum vehicle weight is not more than 7.5 tons

questions.comment: In populated areas on roads that have three or more lanes for traffic in a given direction (as in this case), traffic is limited to the leftmost lane. You can drive in the remaining lanes regardless of the permitted maximum weight of the truck. (Clause 9.4 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Location of vehicles on the roadway

questions.question: Is overtaking allowed in the tunnel?

answers.text: Allowed only in the presence of artificial lighting

questions.comment: Overtaking is prohibited on bridges, overpasses, overpasses and under them, as well as in tunnels. (Clause 11.4 of traffic rules)

questions.question: The truck driver violated the stopping rules:

answers.text: Stopped on the side of the road
Stopping in front of a road sign
Blocking the road sign from other drivers

questions.comment: The truck driver violated clause 12.4 of the traffic rules, which prohibits stopping in places where the vehicle would block traffic lights and road signs from other drivers. In this case, he blocked the visibility of sign 3.27 “Stopping is prohibited”, the coverage area of which begins from the place where the sign was installed (“Road signs”)

questions.question: In what case are you required to give way to a truck?

answers.text: In both of the above cases

questions.comment: The intersection is controlled. You are allowed to move. When turning left or making a U-turn, you must give way to vehicles moving straight and to the right from the opposite direction. Yield to the truck in both of the listed cases. (Clause 13.3, 13.4 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: You intend to continue driving straight when the traffic light is flashing yellow. What are your actions?

answers.text: Stop and continue driving only when the traffic light turns green
Give way to a horse-drawn carriage
Pass the intersection first together with an oncoming car

questions.comment: An intersection with a flashing yellow traffic light is unregulated, in this case it is equivalent, since there are no priority signs. We are guided by the “right hand rule”, i.e. whoever has an obstacle on the right concedes. You have an obstacle on the right - you will be the last to cross the intersection, giving way to a horse-drawn cart. (Clause 13.3, 13.11 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: You intend to turn left. Who do you have to give way to?
questions.comment: The intersection is unequal. The main road changes direction. Vehicles on the main road have priority and are guided by the “right-hand rule” among themselves. After they pass, guided by the same rule, vehicles on the secondary road will pass. You pass first, without yielding to anyone. The motorcyclist is second, the bus is third, the passenger car is last. (Clause 13.9, 13.1, 13.11 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: In what case is the driver of a vehicle approaching an unregulated pedestrian crossing obliged to give way to pedestrians?

answers.text: If pedestrians enter the roadway (tram tracks) to cross
In both of the above cases

questions.comment: The driver of a vehicle approaching an unregulated pedestrian crossing must comply with the requirements to “give way.” This requirement must be met in both of the listed cases. (Clause 14.1 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Pedestrian crossings and stops of fixed-route vehicles

questions.question: Should you switch the high beam to low beam if the driver of an oncoming vehicle periodically switches the headlights to indicate the need for this?

answers.text: Yes, but only if the distance to the oncoming vehicle is less than 150 m

questions.comment: The periodic switching of headlights is a kind of request to you by the driver of an oncoming car to switch the lights on your vehicle in order to avoid blinding.(Clause 19.2 of the SDA, "Vehicle Control Technique")
topic: Use of external lighting fixtures and audible signals

questions.question: What administrative penalty can be imposed on the driver of a vehicle for leaving the scene of a traffic accident in which he is a participant in violation of the Rules?

answers.text: Only a fine of 1000 to 1500 rubles
A fine of 1,000 to 1,500 rubles or deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for a period of 1 to 1.5 years
Deprivation of the right to drive vehicles for a period of 1 to 1.5 years or administrative arrest for a period of up to 15 days

questions.comment: According to Art. 12.27 part 2, the driver of a vehicle for leaving, in violation of the Rules, the scene of a traffic accident in which he is a participant is subject to punishment by deprivation of the right to drive a vehicle for a period of 1 to 1.5 years or administrative arrest for a period of up to 15 days. “Code of the Russian Federation on Administrative Offenses”

questions.question: To prevent a vehicle with a manual transmission from rolling away during a short stop on an uphill slope, you should:

answers.text: Engage first gear or reverse gear
Move the gear shift lever to neutral position

questions.comment: When stopping briefly on an incline, the parking brake should be applied on a vehicle with a manual transmission.

questions.question: Does the choice of lateral interval depend on the speed of travel?

answers.text: The choice of lateral interval does not depend on the speed of movement
When driving speed increases, the lateral interval must be increased
When driving speed increases, the lateral interval can be reduced

questions.comment: Any vehicle structurally has a “dynamic corridor”, i.e. its lateral deviation from linear motion. The “traffic corridor” is especially large for long vehicles and vehicle trains. With an increase in traffic speed, it is necessary to increase the lateral interval with both passing and oncoming vehicles.

questions.question: Subcategory “С1” includes vehicles (except for vehicles of category “D”), the permissible maximum weight of which is:

answers.text: More than 2.5 tons, but not more than 7.5 tons
More than 3.5 tons, but not more than 7.5 tons
More than 3.5 tons, but not more than 12 tons

questions.comment: According to Art. 25 of the Federal Law “On Road Safety”, subcategory С1 includes cars (except for vehicles of category D), r.m.m. which exceeds 3.5 tons, but does not exceed 7.5 tons.

questions.question: Which of the following signs informs you that you are approaching the beginning of a section of road with oncoming traffic?
questions.comment: Only warning sign “А” - 1.21 “Two-way traffic” - is installed in front of a roadway with oncoming traffic, if it was preceded by a section of road with one-way traffic. Sign “Б” - 5.8 “Reversible traffic” - informs about the beginning of a section of the road on which the direction of movement on one or more lanes can change to the opposite. Sign “В” - 5.15.7 “Direction of traffic along lanes” - indicates the organization of traffic in both directions on a three-lane road. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: You are permitted to continue driving a truck with a permissible maximum weight of 12 tons and an actual weight of 8 tons:
questions.comment: Signs 3.4 “Truck traffic prohibited” and 8.3.3 “Direction of action” prohibit the movement of trucks and vehicle combinations with a permissible maximum weight of more than 10 tons on the road being crossed. You can drive straight or turn around. The actual weight in this case does not matter. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: What does this road sign with a yellow background inform you about?

answers.text: Further movement is possible only in the second lane
Further movement is only possible on the carriageway in the opposite direction
Further movement is only possible on another road

questions.comment: Sign 6.19.1 “Preliminary indicator for changing lanes onto another carriageway” indicates the direction of the detour of a section of the roadway closed to traffic on a road with a dividing strip. The yellow background of the sign indicates that the detour is temporary. (“Road Signs”)

questions.question: Are you allowed to cross a double solid horizontal line?

answers.text: Allowed only when leaving courtyards and other adjacent areas

questions.comment: It is PROHIBITED to cross the double continuous horizontal marking 1.3 separating traffic flows in opposite directions. (“Horizontal marking”)

questions.question: What do the arrows on a green traffic light inform you about?

answers.text: Right turns are always prohibited at this intersection.
Movement to the right is regulated by an additional section
This intersection allows left turns from two lanes.

questions.comment: Black contour arrows placed on the main green traffic light inform drivers about the presence of an additional section of the traffic light and indicate other permitted directions of movement than the additional section signal. (Clause 6.4 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: Such a hand signal given by the driver of a passenger car informs you:

answers.text: About his intention to start a movement
About the danger around the corner

questions.comment: The left hand extended to the side is a left turn signal, which the driver must give before starting to move. (Clause 8.1 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: In which direction is the truck driver allowed to continue driving?
questions.comment: As an exception, entering a roundabout intersection can be done from any lane in that direction (without first changing lanes). Departure from this intersection is carried out according to the general rules. To turn right, you must take the appropriate extreme position on the roadway in advance. When making a turn, the vehicle should move as close as possible to the right edge of the roadway. The truck driver can continue driving in a circle and, turning on the right turn signal, turn right, i.e. continue moving in any direction listed. (“Road signs”, paragraphs 8.5, 8.6 of traffic rules)

questions.question: You can continue driving at the intersection:
questions.comment: U-turns are not prohibited at intersections. In this situation, you can continue moving in any direction. (Clause 8.11 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Driving in a populated area at a speed of more than 60 km/h is permitted:

answers.text: Only if there are road signs allowing driving at speeds over 60 km/h
In both of the above cases

questions.comment: In populated areas, the speed is limited: it should not exceed 60 km/h. Increased speed can be introduced on certain sections of roads by installing signs 3.24 “Maximum speed limit”. (Clause 10.2 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: In this situation, the advantage is:

answers.text: Passenger car as it moves uphill
Truck, as the obstacle is in the lane of a passenger car

questions.comment: If it is difficult to pass oncoming traffic on slopes indicated by the corresponding signs 1.13 “Steep descent”, 1.14 “Steep ascent”, the driver of the vehicle moving downhill must give way. In this traffic situation, the truck driver yields. The driver of a passenger car has an advantage because he is moving uphill. (Clause 11.7 of traffic rules)

questions.question: Can you park your car at the specified location?

answers.text: Only possible if road visibility is at least 100m

questions.comment: If there is a pull-off to the side of the road, you can also park your car in places with limited visibility. (Clause 12.1, 12.4, 12.5 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: What should you do when turning left?

answers.text: Stop at the stop line and wait for the traffic controller's signal to allow the turn.
Having arrived at the intersection, stop and wait for the traffic controller's signal to allow the turn.
Turn, giving way to an oncoming car

questions.comment: The intersection is controlled. The traffic controller has his hands down. Trackless vehicles are allowed to move straight and to the right from the right and left sides. You intend to turn left. Therefore, you need to stop in front of the stop line and wait for the traffic controller’s signal corresponding to your intention, and then perform the maneuver. (Clause 6.10, 6.13, 13.3 of the Traffic Regulations, “Horizontal markings” 1.12)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: You intend to drive straight through the intersection. What are your actions?

answers.text: Pass the intersection together with the tram, without giving way to a truck
Drive through the intersection, giving way to a truck

questions.comment: The intersection is equal. A tram at equivalent intersections has an advantage over trackless vehicles, regardless of its further direction of movement. Trackless vehicles are guided among themselves by the “right hand rule”, i.e. whoever has an obstacle on the right gives way. You have an obstacle on the right - give way to a truck. (Clause 13.11 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Who do you have to give way to when driving straight?
questions.comment: The intersection is unequal. The main road changes direction. Vehicles on the main road have priority and are guided by the “right-hand rule” among themselves. After them, guided by the same rule, vehicles on the secondary road pass through the intersection. The motorcyclist will pass first, the bus will pass second, and the car will pass third. You are the last, giving way to all vehicles. (Clause 13.9, 13.10, 13.11 Traffic Rules)

questions.question: Is driving instruction allowed on this road?

answers.text: Allowed, only when driving in the far right lane of the roadway

questions.comment: Traffic follows sign 5.1 on the motorway. Training driving on it is not prohibited, i.e. permitted. (“Road signs”, clause 16.1 of the traffic rules).
topic: Training riding and additional requirements for the movement of cyclists

questions.question: Is it possible to use fog lights instead of low beam headlights during daylight hours?

answers.text: Possible, except when driving in tunnels and in poor visibility conditions

questions.comment: Permitted during daylight hours, except when driving in tunnels and in conditions of poor visibility. (Clause 19.4, 19.5 of traffic rules)
topic: Use of external lighting fixtures and audible signals

questions.question: Is it allowed to install tires with different tread patterns on the same truck axle?

answers.text: Allowed only on the rear axle

questions.comment: Tires with different tread patterns behave differently due to uneven traction between the wheels and the road. The consequence of this difference can be the car skidding both when moving along a curved path and when braking. (“Basic provisions”, “List of faults” clause 5.8)
topic: Malfunctions and conditions for admitting vehicles to operation

questions.question: In case of loss of wheel traction due to the formation of a “water wedge”, the driver should:

answers.text: Reduce speed by sharply pressing the brake pedal

questions.comment: Water sliding - or so-called aquaplaning - occurs when driving a passenger car in heavy rain or when driving through accumulations of water on the road in lowlands: in autumn, spring or during a thaw. Knowing about this phenomenon, the driver should not be taken by surprise. There can only be one piece of advice - immediately reduce the speed by applying engine braking. “Driving techniques”

questions.question: How does a driver's fatigue affect his attention and reaction?

answers.text: Attention and reaction time do not change

questions.comment: Fatigue and tiredness undoubtedly affect traffic safety. Attention weakens, reaction time increases. A good driver should take pauses in movement, which from time to time will interrupt the monotony of driving. A few minutes are often enough to restore the level of attention necessary for safe movement. (“Driving School”, A.I. Kopusov-Dolinin, EKSMO Publishing House)

questions.question: At the request of which persons are drivers required to undergo an examination for alcohol intoxication and a medical examination for intoxication?

answers.text: Officials authorized to exercise federal state control (supervision) in the field of road safety

questions.comment: The driver is required to undergo an examination for alcohol intoxication and a medical examination for intoxication at the request of officials who are granted the right of state supervision and control over road safety and operation of the vehicle. (Clause 2.3.2 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Which of the following signs informs you that at an intersection you must give way to vehicles approaching from the left?
questions.comment: The order of passage of vehicles at intersections is determined by the priority signs indicated in this case "А" and "Б".The sign "А" - 2.3.3 "Junction of a secondary road" - informs that the adjacent road on the left is secondary. Moving along the main road, you have an advantage. The combination of signs "Б" - 2.4 "Give way" with the sign 8.13 "Direction of the main road" informs that moving vehicles located on the main road on the left and directly from the opposite direction have an advantage. You are obliged to give way to them. Sign "В" - 5.13.1 "Exit to the road with a lane for fixed-route vehicles" - is included in the group of signs of special regulations. It cannot regulate the order of passage of vehicles.(“Traffic Signs”)

questions.question: Are you allowed to continue driving forward with a truck and trailer?
