answers.text: Allowed if you serve a business located in a designated area

questions.comment: Those who live, work or service enterprises located in the area of the sign are exempt from the effect of sign 3.7 “Moving with a trailer is prohibited.” (“Road signs”)

questions.question: You are allowed to move:

answers.text: In any of the directions indicated

questions.comment: Sign 5.7.2 “Entering a one-way road” prohibits turning right, i.e. oncoming traffic. The permitted directions of movement at such an intersection are straight, left (in the direction of the arrow on the sign) and a U-turn. You can continue moving in any direction indicated. ("Road Signs")

questions.question: What does increasing the stroke length of a dashed marking line inform you about?

answers.text: About the beginning of the zone where any maneuvers are prohibited
About the beginning of a dangerous section of the road
On approaching a solid marking line dividing traffic flows in the same direction

questions.comment: Marking 1.6 (the approach line is a broken line, the length of the strokes is three times longer than the spaces between them) warns of approaching the solid line 1.1 (maybe 1.11), which separates traffic flows, in this case, passing directions. (“Horizontal markings”)

questions.question: Can you change lanes into the next lane?

answers.text: Yes, if the truck is moving at a speed of 30 km/h

questions.comment: To perform the maneuver, you would be forced to enter the reversible lane. The red signal of the reversing traffic light prohibits movement in this lane. (Clause 6.7 of the Traffic Regulations, “Horizontal markings”)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: Are you required to turn on your right turn signals before entering this intersection?

answers.text: Obligated only in the presence of vehicles moving behind

questions.comment: When entering the roundabout, you make a right turn. You should inform other road users about this by turning on the right direction indicators.(Clause 8.1 of SDA)

questions.question: When leaving the adjacent territory, you must give way to:

answers.text: Vehicles, persons using personal mobility devices and pedestrians

questions.comment: When entering the road from the adjacent territory, the driver must give way to: vehicles, persons using personal mobility devices and pedestrians. (Clause 8.3 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Is it permissible to make a U-turn on a section of the road marked with this sign?

answers.text: Allowed only when road visibility is at least 100 m

questions.comment: By making a U-turn on a road marked with sign 5.5 “One-way road”, you will make oncoming traffic, which is unacceptable on this road. (“Road Signs”)

questions.question: In what cases is a driver prohibited from driving outside populated areas at a speed of more than 60 km/h?

answers.text: When transporting people in the back of a truck
For organized transportation of groups of children
If such a maximum speed is established when agreeing on the conditions for the transportation of large, heavy or dangerous goods
In all of the above cases

questions.comment: In all of the above cases, the driver is prohibited from driving at a speed of more than 60 km/h (Clause 10.3, 10.4 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Is overtaking allowed at a pedestrian crossing?

answers.text: Prohibited only if there are pedestrians on it

questions.comment: Overtaking is prohibited at pedestrian crossings. (Clause 11.4 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Where can you stop?
questions.comment: Outside a populated area, stopping or parking is permitted only on the right side of the road - on the side of the road, and in its absence - at the edge of the roadway. You will do the right thing if you stop at place “В”. (Clause 12.1 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: What should you do when turning left?

answers.text: Give way only to a truck with a flashing light on

questions.comment: The intersection is controlled. Priority signs don't work. A truck with a “yellow flashing light” stands and waits for a traffic light signal allowing it to move, since a special yellow signal does not allow deviating from the requirements of traffic lights. When turning left, you must give way to vehicles moving directly from the opposite direction. Give way to the bus. (Clause 3.4, 13.3, 13.4 Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: You intend to turn around. What are your actions?

answers.text: Be the first to turn around
Enter the intersection and, giving way to a passenger car, complete a U-turn
You will act by mutual agreement with the driver of the car

questions.comment: The intersection is equal. When determining the order of passage through an intersection, drivers are guided by the “right-hand rule.” During a U-turn, you will see an obstacle on the right, give way. (Clause 13.11 of traffic rules)

questions.question: Who do you have to give way to when driving straight?
questions.comment: The intersection is unequal. The main road changes direction. Vehicles located on the main road have an advantage, while trackless vehicles are guided by the “right-hand rule” among themselves, yielding to a tram that is in equal conditions with them. You give way to a tram and a car, which will pass the intersection at the same time, since their trajectories do not intersect. The motorcyclist is inferior to everyone because he is on a secondary road. (“Road signs”, paragraphs 13.9, 13.10, 13.11 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Is it permitted to drive on the highway in a vehicle whose technical speed is less than 40 km/h?

answers.text: Allowed only in the far right lane

questions.comment: The movement of vehicles whose speed, according to their technical characteristics or their condition, is less than 40 km/h is prohibited on highways (Clause 16.1 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Carriage of cargo is prohibited if it:

answers.text: Protrudes more than 1 m beyond the dimensions of the vehicle at the front or rear and is marked with identification marks
Covers external lighting devices, retroreflectors, registration and identification plates

questions.comment: According to clause 23.3 of the traffic rules, the carriage of goods is prohibited under the conditions listed in the second answer. When cargo protrudes more than 1 m beyond the dimensions of the vehicle in front or behind, transportation is not prohibited. But in this case, the cargo must be marked with the identification sign “Large vehicle”, and in the dark and in conditions of insufficient visibility with lighting devices. (Clause 23.4 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Is it permissible to drive a vehicle to a repair or parking site at night with the headlights and tail lights off (due to a malfunction)?

answers.text: Allowed only on roads with artificial lighting

questions.comment: In the event of this malfunction, in the dark or in conditions of insufficient visibility, movement to both the repair site and the parking area is strictly prohibited, regardless of the availability of road lighting. (Clause 2.3.1 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Malfunctions and conditions for admitting vehicles to operation

questions.question: When turning left, traffic safety is achieved by turning along the trajectory shown:
questions.comment: If the parameters (mass and speed) of moving cars in both figures are the same, then the centrifugal force tending to skid the car is theoretically less in the right figure, because the trajectory of movement passes along a larger radius of curvature. But the driver has no reserve (he exits the turn at the very edge of the roadway), and all the factors affecting the car cannot always be taken into account. The trajectory of movement shown in the left figure is preferable, because it is more secure. In this situation, the driver, before entering the turn, took the correct position of the vehicle on the roadway, placing it at its outer boundary. When moving along a curved path, in this case he always has a reserve in the width of the roadway. It is very important for the driver to accustom himself to reducing the speed by at least one third before entering a turn, so that in the future this will happen automatically. (“Driving Techniques”)

questions.question: How to ensure restoration of the victim's airway when preparing him for cardiopulmonary resuscitation?

answers.text: Lay the victim on his back on a hard surface, tilt his head back, place one hand on his forehead, lifting his chin with two fingers of the other hand.
Lay the victim on his side, tilt his head to his chest. If there is mucus and vomit, clean the mouth from them.
Lay the victim on his back and, without throwing his head back, squeeze his cheeks to spread his lips and open his mouth. If there is mucus and vomit, clean the mouth from them.

questions.comment: Initially, the victim in this situation needs to clear the oral cavity of mucus and vomit, then, according to the correct answer, lay the victim on his back on a hard surface, throw back his head, put one hand on his forehead, lifting his chin with two fingers of the other hand.

questions.question: What maneuver does the driver of a small bus intend to perform?
questions.comment: The driver of a small bus “changes lanes” into a parallel lane and further “advances” - the vehicle moves at a speed greater than the speed of the same-direction vehicle (Clause 1.2 of the Traffic Regulations, the terms “Lane change” and “Advancing”).

questions.question: This sign:

answers.text: Shows traffic directions at the intersection
Indicates that the road being crossed has two lanes of traffic.
Prohibits making a U-turn at an intersection

questions.comment: Warning sign 1.34.3 "Direction of turn" indicates the direction of movement at the T-junction.(“Traffic Signs”)

questions.question: These signs apply to:

answers.text: Only for trucks with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons

questions.comment: Plate 8.4.1 “Type of vehicle” extends the sign to trucks, including those with a trailer, with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Which sign indicates the length of the turnaround zone?
questions.comment: Sign “Б” - 6.3.2 “Turn zone” is used to indicate the place on the road section that allows a turn, and its length. In this case, the length of the turnaround zone is no more than 15 m. The combination of signs “А” - 6.3.1 “Place for a turn” and plate 8.1.1 “Distance to object” indicate that 50 m from the installation of signs in the direction of travel there will be a place intended only for making a turn. The length of the turning zone in this situation is not specified. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: This markup means:

answers.text: A section of the road where driving near the sidewalk is prohibited
Places where any stopping is prohibited

questions.comment: Yellow zigzag markings 1.17.1 indicate stopping places for route vehicles and taxi ranks. (“Horizontal markings”)

questions.question: In what cases is it necessary to give way to a vehicle that has special color schemes applied to its external surfaces?

answers.text: If his driver turned on a blue flashing light and a special sound signal
If his driver turned on the blue flashing light

questions.comment: To gain an advantage, the “operative” must turn on a blue flashing light and a special sound signal. (Clause 3.1 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Does signaling with turn signals give you an advantage in traffic?
questions.comment: Signaling with direction indicators does not give the driver an advantage and does not exempt him from taking precautions.(Clause 8.2 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: Are you allowed to make a right turn along the indicated trajectory in this situation?
questions.comment: When turning right, the vehicle should move as close as possible to the right edge of the roadway, i.e. in the far right lane. In this case, you do not have such an opportunity due to the car stopping in this lane. Continue moving along the indicated trajectory. (Clause 8.6 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Can you make a U-turn?
questions.comment: You are on a one-way road on which oncoming traffic is prohibited. You cannot continue driving along the indicated trajectories. (“Road signs” 5.6, 1.21)

questions.question: In what cases is it prohibited to drive in the lane intended for oncoming traffic on dual carriageway roads?

answers.text: If it is separated by tram tracks
If it is separated by a dividing strip
If it is separated by dividing markings 1.1 or 1.3, or markings 1.11, the broken line of which is located on the left
In all of the above cases

questions.comment: On any two-way roads, it is prohibited to drive in a lane intended for oncoming traffic if it is separated by tram tracks, a dividing strip, marking 1.1, marking 1.3 or marking 1.11, the broken line of which is located on the left. (Clause 9.1(1) Traffic Regulations) Changes in traffic regulations from July 12, 2017.
topic: Location of vehicles on the roadway

questions.question: Are you allowed to overtake a truck at the end of a hill?

answers.text: Permitted if the speed of the truck is no more than 30 km/h

questions.comment: Fracture of the road limits visibility at the end of the climb. Therefore, overtaking is prohibited.(Clause 11.4 of the SDA)Do not forget the main condition for overtaking - "The path necessary for overtaking should never exceed half of the visible segment of the path."

questions.question: Are you allowed to park your car in this place if there is a narrow shoulder?
questions.comment: Parking outside populated areas on the roadway marked with sign 2.1 “Main Road” is prohibited. (Clause 12.5 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: What should you do when turning right?

answers.text: Give way only to tram А
Give way only to tram Б

questions.comment: To turn right you must cross the tram tracks. Both trams, just like you, have the right to move; they move “in the hands of the traffic controller.” You give way to them, since with the simultaneous right to travel, the tram has an advantage over trackless vehicles. (Clause 6.10, 13.6 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: You intend to turn left. What are your actions?

answers.text: Enter the intersection first and, giving way to the motorcycle, complete the turn

questions.comment: The intersection is equal. Drivers follow the “right-hand rule” among themselves. You start moving first, because at the initial moment there is no obstacle on the right. Having rolled out to the intersection, stop just before turning left. After this, along the trajectory of the passenger car there will be no obstacle on the right - the motorcyclist will pass through the intersection first, the motorcyclist will be second, and you will be the last. (Clause 13.11 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: You are required to give way when driving straight:
questions.comment: The intersection is unequal. The main road changes direction. Vehicles located on the main road have priority, which are guided by the “right-hand rule” among themselves. You are on a secondary road, give way to both vehicles. (“Road signs” 2.4, 8.13; clauses 13.9, 13.10, 13.11 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Which drivers are breaking the rules?

answers.text: Drivers of mopeds and trucks with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons

questions.comment: Mopeds are prohibited on the highway. It is also prohibited for trucks with a r.m.m. of more than 2.5 tons to move on any road that has three lanes in a given direction in the leftmost lane. Drivers of trucks and mopeds violate the rules (Clauses 9.4, 16.1 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: When dazzled by the high beam headlights of oncoming or passing vehicles, the driver must:

answers.text: Move right to the edge of the roadway and stop
Turn on the hazard warning lights and, without changing lanes, reduce speed and stop

questions.comment: Try to perform the actions in the sequence specified by the Rules - turn on the alarm and, without changing lanes, slow down and stop.(Clause 19.2 of the Traffic Rules)
topic: Use of external lighting fixtures and audible signals

questions.question: What types of administrative penalties can be applied to drivers for violations of the Rules?

answers.text: Warning, fine, deprivation of the right to drive vehicles, administrative arrest
Warning, fine, deprivation of the right to drive vehicles, confiscation of the instrument of commission or the subject of an administrative offense, administrative arrest, compulsory work

questions.comment: According to Chapter 12 of the Code of Administrative Offences, all types of punishments listed in the answers may be applied to drivers for violating traffic rules. The correct answer is the most complete. “Code of the Russian Federation on Administrative Offences”

questions.question: What driver actions will lead to a decrease in the centrifugal force generated when turning?
questions.comment: The most effective quantity influencing centrifugal force is speed. It is proportional to the square of the speed. At the same time, the speed is determined by the driver. Its decrease leads to a decrease in centrifugal force. That is why it is recommended to reduce your speed before entering a turn. (“Driving Techniques”)

questions.question: How does alcohol affect a driver's reaction time?

answers.text: Alcohol does not affect reaction time

questions.comment: The driver behind the wheel requires not only a reaction, which increases when drinking alcohol. The most important thing is to constantly assess events and predict their development. Under the influence of alcohol, the brain makes incorrect assessments, and this is the main danger of driving while intoxicated. “Transport Psychology.”

questions.question: The main road is shown:

answers.text: Only in the top left picture
Only in the top right picture

questions.comment: In the top left picture, the main road is indicated by sign 5.1 "Motorway". In the upper right picture there is sign 2.3.2 “Junction of a secondary road.” (“Road signs”)

questions.question: At what distance to a slippery section of the road is this sign installed in a populated area?

answers.text: Just before the start of the slippery section

questions.comment: In populated areas, most warning signs are installed at a distance of 50-100 m from the dangerous area. At this distance, sign 1.15 “Slippery road” is also installed. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: This sign prohibits the movement of vehicles:

answers.text: The permissible maximum weight of which is more than 6 tons
The actual weight of which is more than 6 tons
The actual mass of which, per any axle, is more than 6 tons

questions.comment: Sign 3.12 “Limitation of mass per vehicle axle” prohibits the movement of vehicles whose (actual) load on any of the axles is greater than that indicated on the sign. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Which of the following signs are used to indicate camping?
questions.comment: Service signs inform about the location of the relevant facilities. Designated signs: “Б” - 7.10 “Camping”; “А” - 7.9 “Hotel or motel”; “В” - 7.11 “Resting Place.” (“Road Signs”)

questions.question: If you are driving a small bus, then if the reversible traffic lights are turned off, you should:

answers.text: Immediately change lanes to the right into the adjacent lane
Continue along the lane only until the intersection
If there are no oncoming vehicles, continue driving along the lane

questions.comment: When the signals of the reversing traffic light, which is located above the lane marked on both sides by markings 1.9, are turned off, entry into this lane is prohibited. You need to change lanes to the right lane. (Clause 6.7 of the Traffic Regulations, “Horizontal markings”)

questions.question: You are allowed to continue driving:
questions.comment: Both the burning arrow of the additional section of the traffic light, and the sign 5.15.1 “Directions of traffic along the lanes”, and the markings allow you to make a left turn from the extreme left lane and a U-turn to move in the opposite direction. (“Road Signs”, paragraph 6.3 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: How should a towed vehicle be marked if the hazard warning lights are missing or faulty?

answers.text: Install a warning triangle on the rear of the towed vehicle.
Turn on the rear fog light

questions.comment: If there is no or faulty hazard warning light on a towed motor vehicle, a warning triangle must be attached to its rear part. (Clause 7.3 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Use of hazard warning lights and warning triangles

questions.question: Is it possible for a car driver in this situation to start driving from the sidewalk?

answers.text: It is possible, if this does not interfere with a truck moving in the left lane

questions.comment: The driver of a car located in the far right lane can start moving if he does not interfere with a truck moving in the left lane. (Clause 8.1 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: The driver accidentally passed the required entrance to the yard. Is he allowed to use reverse in this situation and then turn right?

answers.text: It is allowed if it does not interfere with the movement of route vehicles.

questions.comment: Reversing is prohibited at stopping points. Such a maneuver is prohibited for you in this situation, since you are going to perform it at the stopping place of route vehicles, which is indicated by sign 5.16 “Bus and trolleybus stopping place”, as well as zigzag yellow markings 1.17.1. (Clause 8.11, 8.12 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: The number of traffic lanes on the roadway is determined:

answers.text: By markings or signs, and if there are none, then by the driver himself

questions.comment: The number of traffic lanes for trackless vehicles is determined by signs, markings, and if there are none, mentally by the driver himself, taking into account the width of the roadway, the dimensions of the vehicles and the required intervals between them. (Clause 9.1 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Location of vehicles on the roadway

questions.question: Is it possible for you to continue driving in the middle lane after passing a car moving in the right lane?

answers.text: Only possible if there is no oncoming traffic

questions.comment: The middle lane in this situation is used for traffic in both directions. It is only intended for overtaking, passing, turning left or making a U-turn. Having finished overtaking, you need to change lanes to the far right lane. (Clause 9.3 of the Traffic Regulations). You carry out further movement in accordance with clause 9.4 of the traffic rules. “Outside populated areas, vehicle drivers should drive them as close as possible to the right edge of the roadway.” You have such an opportunity.
topic: Location of vehicles on the roadway

questions.question: Is it possible for you to stop a truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons in this place?

answers.text: Can only be loaded or unloaded

questions.comment: In a populated area, on a road that has one lane in each direction, without tram tracks in the middle, stopping and parking in the direction of travel and on the left side of the road is allowed. This rule applies to all vehicles, without any restrictions. (Clause 12.1 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: What should you do when moving in a forward direction?

answers.text: Wait for another signal from the traffic controller

questions.comment: The intersection is adjustable. Trams move only "in the direction of the regulator's hands", i.e. straight. Tram driver is not allowed to turn right. Accordingly, he stands and waits for the regulator's signal to change. You can continue straight ahead or to the right. You pass the intersection first. (Clause 6.10 of the traffic rules)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: Who do you have to give way to when turning left?
questions.comment: The intersection is equal. Drivers are guided by the “right hand rule”. The only obstacle on your right is a car, so you must give way to it. (Clause 13.11 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: You intend to turn left. What are your actions?

answers.text: Give way only to passenger cars
Give way only to the bus

questions.comment: The intersection is unequal. The main road changes direction. Vehicles located on the main road have priority, which are guided by the “right-hand rule” among themselves. After they pass, vehicles on the secondary road pass. You are on a secondary road. Yield to both vehicles. (Clause 13.9, 13.10, 13.11 Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: The stop signal for the train driver is the following position of the hand or hands (in the daytime with a piece of bright material or some clearly visible object, at night - with a torch or lantern):
questions.comment: The stop signal for the train driver is a circular movement of the hand (in the daytime with a piece of bright material or some clearly visible object, at night - with a torch or lantern). (Clause 15.5 of the Traffic Regulations. Note)

questions.question: In a tunnel with artificial lighting the following must be included:

answers.text: Low beam headlights or side lights
Low beam headlights or daytime running lights

questions.comment: Regardless of the illumination of the tunnel, when entering it, the high or low beam headlights must be turned on. (Clause 19.1 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Use of external lighting fixtures and audible signals

questions.question: Criminal liability is provided for driving a vehicle that does not cause serious harm to health or death of a person by a person in a state of intoxication, if he has previously been subject to administrative punishment:

answers.text: For failure to comply with the legal requirement of an authorized official to undergo a medical examination for intoxication
For committing any of the listed offenses

questions.comment: According to Article 264.1 of the Criminal Code, criminal liability is provided in this situation for committing any of the listed offenses.

questions.question: When driving on a two-lane road behind a truck, you have the opportunity to overtake. What are your actions?

answers.text: Get as close as possible to the vehicle you are overtaking, then change lanes into oncoming traffic and complete the maneuver
Change lanes into oncoming traffic, then approach the vehicle you are overtaking and complete the maneuver

questions.comment: The heavy truck ahead is a “moving wall” that limits your visibility. Only at a distance can you see the distance sufficient for overtaking, inform in a timely manner and be noticed by the overtaken. If necessary, stop overtaking in a timely manner and return to your lane. (“Driving techniques”)

questions.question: How is cardiopulmonary resuscitation performed on a victim?

answers.text: Artificial respiration and manual pressure on the victim’s sternum: first, 1 breath using the “mouth to mouth” method, then 15 pressures on the sternum
Hand pressure on the victim’s sternum and artificial respiration: first 15 pressures on the sternum, then 1 breath using the “mouth to mouth” method
Hand pressure on the victim’s sternum and artificial respiration: first 30 pressures on the sternum, then 2 breaths using the “mouth to mouth” method

questions.comment: Cardiopulmonary resuscitation is carried out by manual pressure on the victim’s sternum and artificial ventilation of the lungs, first 30 pressures on the sternum, then 2 breaths using the “mouth to mouth” method. In the correct answer, the sum of the actions is “32”.

questions.question: What does the term "Lack of Visibility" mean?

answers.text: Road visibility is less than 100 m near dangerous turns and bends in the longitudinal profile of the road
Road visibility is less than 150 m at night
Road visibility is less than 300 m in conditions of fog, rain, snowfall, etc., as well as at dusk.

questions.comment: “Insufficient visibility” - visibility of the road is less than 300m in conditions of fog, rain, snowfall and the like, as well as at dusk. Clause 1.2 the term “Insufficient visibility”.

questions.question: You can continue at the following intersection:

answers.text: In any of the directions indicated

questions.comment: In this case, sign 4.1.1 “Go straight” is installed behind the intersection of roadways, i.e. at the beginning of the road section. The effect of the sign in such a situation extends to the nearest intersection. Therefore, you can continue driving in all indicated directions. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Which of the following signs permit driving at a speed of 60 km/h?
questions.comment: Signs: “Б” - 4.6 “Minimum speed limit”, “В” - 6.2 “Recommended speed”. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Which driver violated the parking rules?
questions.comment: Drivers of trucks who have sign 6.4 “Parking (parking space)” with any of the signs 8.6.2, 8.6.3 and 8.6.6-8.6.9 “Method of placing vehicles” cannot stand in the coverage area of the combination of these signs. (“Road signs”) Drivers of a passenger car and motorcycle, in accordance with sign 6.4 “Parking (parking space)” and plate 8.6.3, absolutely correctly complied with the requirements of the Rules. (Clause 12.2 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: You can go around an obstacle:

answers.text: Along any trajectory of the specified

questions.comment: Signs take precedence over markings. Therefore, according to sign 4.2.2 “Avoiding obstacles on the left”, you must continue moving along trajectory “А”. (“Road signs”, “Horizontal markings”)

questions.question: What does the combination of red and yellow traffic lights mean?

answers.text: Green light will be on soon
The red light will be on soon

questions.comment: The combination of red and yellow traffic lights prohibits movement and informs about the upcoming turning on of the green signal. (Clause 6.2 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: At what distance from the vehicle should a warning triangle be placed in this situation?
questions.comment: The action takes place outside a populated area, so the distance at which a warning triangle is installed is greater than in a populated area. Install the sign according to the situation, but this distance must be at least 30 m. (Clause 7.2 of the traffic rules)
topic: Use of hazard warning lights and warning triangles

questions.question: Who should you give way to when turning into the yard?
questions.comment: When turning left outside an intersection, the driver of a trackless vehicle is obliged to give way to oncoming vehicles and pedestrians whose path he is crossing. (Clause 8.3, 8.8 of traffic rules)

questions.question: To ensure safety when reversing from a parking space with limited visibility, you must:
questions.comment: Reversing a vehicle is permitted provided that this maneuver is safe and does not interfere with other road users. If necessary, the driver must resort to the help of other persons. (Clause 8.12 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: At what maximum speed do you have the right to continue driving a truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons after entering the road adjacent to the left?
questions.comment: The action takes place in a populated area, indicated by sign 5.23.1 “Beginning of a populated area” (with a white background). Speed in such populated areas is limited. The permissible maximum speed is 60 km/h (“Road signs”, clause 10.2 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: What should you do in this situation?

answers.text: Give way to an oncoming car
Act by mutual agreement with the driver of the oncoming car

questions.comment: If oncoming traffic is difficult to pass, the driver on whose side there is an obstacle must give way. In this situation, the advantage is yours - you pass first. (Clause 11.7 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Drivers of which trucks with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons did not violate parking rules?
questions.comment: Place “В” is located within the coverage area of sign 3.27 “Stopping is prohibited”, the effect of which, according to plate 8.2.3 “Validity area”, ends behind the sign. Therefore, you can stop at place “Б”. In place “А” on a one-way road, a truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons can stop only for loading or unloading cargo. (“Road signs”, clause 12.1 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: You need to give way to other road users:

answers.text: Only when turning left or making a U-turn
In both of the above cases

questions.comment: When turning right, you must give way to pedestrians. When turning left or making a U-turn, the tram, which has priority in equal conditions, goes to the tram. There are no obstacles when driving straight. The correct answer is in both of the listed cases. (Clause 6.2, 13.1, 13.6 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: You intend to continue straight ahead. What are your actions?

answers.text: Give way to a truck as it approaches from the right
Give way to the truck as it is on the main road

questions.comment: The intersection is equal. Drivers are guided by the “right hand rule”, i.e. whoever has an obstacle on the right concedes. You have an obstacle on the right, the truck has the right of way. (Clause 13.11 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Who do you have to give way to when turning left?

answers.text: A car with a flashing light and a special sound signal turned on

questions.comment: Undoubtedly, an “operative” with a blue flashing light and a siren has an advantage. Everyone else is obliged to ensure his unhindered passage through the intersection. After passing it, you pass, since you are on the main road and have priority over a truck located on a secondary road. (Clause 3.1, 13.9 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: When forced to stop at a railway crossing, if there are passengers in the vehicle, the driver must:

answers.text: Drop people off if the measures taken do not allow the vehicle to be removed from the crossing
Disembark people when a train appears

questions.comment: When forced to stop at a crossing, the driver must immediately unload people and take measures to clear the crossing. (Clause 15.5 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: When stopping and parking on unlit sections of roads at night, you must:
questions.comment: When stopping and parking at night on unlit sections of roads, as well as in conditions of insufficient visibility, the side lights on the vehicle must be turned on. (Clause 19.3 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Use of external lighting fixtures and audible signals

questions.question: In what cases is it permissible to operate a vehicle?

answers.text: The windshield wipers provided by the vehicle manufacturer are faulty or missing
The windshield washers provided by the vehicle manufacturer are faulty or missing

questions.comment: The “List of Faults” prohibits the use of windshield wipers and windshield washers if the specified malfunctions occur. The serviceability of the window lifter is not covered by this list, which means operation is permitted. (“List of faults”, paragraph 4.5)
topic: Malfunctions and conditions for admitting vehicles to operation

questions.question: What is the trajectory of a truck trailer when cornering?

answers.text: Farther from the center of the turn than the vehicle's path
On the trajectory of the car
Closer to the center of the turn than the vehicle's path

questions.comment: When cornering, there is a difference in the radii of the movement of the front and rear wheels. The rear wheels always have a smaller radius; they are always closer to the center of the turn. This is also true for vehicles without a trailer, and even more so with a trailer. This should be taken into account. Sometimes you can observe how the driver of a heavy vehicle or bus, when turning, is forced to deviate from the edge of the roadway, so that the rear wheels do not run into the curb, sidewalk, and the drivers of a passenger car, seeing more space, decide to take advantage of this and jump through, but end up in a “trap.” I feel sorry for them, but they only have themselves to blame for this.

questions.question: It is generally accepted that the average driver reaction time is:
questions.comment: The reaction time for each driver is different and is not a constant value. It has been experimentally determined that the average reaction time of drivers is approximately 1 second. What is a second - say the combination of words “twenty-two”. The time of the second has passed. If the individual reaction time increases, it should be compensated by reducing the average speed of the vehicle. More details about the driver’s reaction, “lost time,” the minimum safe distance, and overtaking are described in the manual “Driving School of the Russian Federation,” published by EKSMO publishing house.

questions.question: The main point at the crossroads is:

answers.text: Road with asphalt concrete surface in relation to the road covered with paving stones
A road with three or more lanes relative to a road with two lanes

questions.comment: In the absence of signs indicating the main road, the paved road in relation to the dirt road is the main one. (Clause 1.2, the term “Main Road”)

questions.question: Are you allowed to enter the bridge at the same time as the motorcycle driver?

answers.text: It is allowed if you do not impede his movement

questions.comment: This sign (2.6) prohibits entering a narrow section of the road only if it would impede oncoming traffic. (“Road Signs”)

questions.question: Which small bus drivers violated parking rules?
questions.comment: The effect of sign 3.27 “Stopping is prohibited” extends to the nearest intersection. You cannot stop at place “А”, you cannot stand. The driver of a small bus, stopping on the side of the road behind an intersection, i.e. in place “Б”, does not violate the rules. (Clause 12.1 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Which of the indicated plates extend the effect of the signs installed with them to trucks with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons?
questions.comment: Plates 8.4.1 (А) and 8.4.3 (Б) “Type of vehicle” apply to: “А” - to trucks, including with a trailer, with a r.m.m. of more than 3.5 tons, “Б” - to passenger cars, as well as trucks with a r.m.m. up to 3.5 tons. Plate 8.6.1 (В) “Method of parking a vehicle” extends the effect of sign 6.4 “Parking (parking space)” to ALL vehicles. Therefore, only plates “А” and “В” apply to trucks whose g.m.m. is more than 3.5 tons (“Road signs”)

questions.question: The right lane is designed to move:

answers.text: Buses and trolleybuses, which are route vehicles, school buses and passenger taxis, as well as cyclists

questions.comment: On the rightmost lane indicated by marking 1.23.1 (in the form of the letter "А") and sign 5.14.1 "Lane for fixed-route vehicles" of the vehicles listed in the responses, buses and trolleybuses moving along the established routes with designated stopping places related to fixed-route vehicles, as well as school buses, passenger taxis and cyclists have the right to move.(Clause 1.2 of traffic rules, "Road signs", "Horizontal marking")

questions.question: What should a truck driver do when an emergency service vehicle approaches?

answers.text: Change over to the right lane
Stop on the right side of the sidewalk

questions.comment: Emergency service vehicles driving with a blue flashing light and a special sound signal on should give way, ensuring unobstructed passage. The truck driver should change lanes to the right and continue driving. (Clause 3.2 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: The driver's arm bent at the elbow is a signal informing you of his intention:

answers.text: Stop to give way to a motorcycle

questions.comment: The signal for a right turn corresponds to the right hand extended to the side or the left hand extended to the side and bent at the elbow at a right angle upward (as in this situation). (Clause 8.1 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: You can continue driving when turning left:

answers.text: Along any trajectory of the specified

questions.comment: When turning left at an intersection, you can choose any direction of movement. The main condition is that when leaving the intersection of roadways, your vehicle should not end up on the side of oncoming traffic. (Clause 8.6 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: If the trajectories of vehicles intersect, and the order of passage is not specified in the Rules, you should:

answers.text: Give way to vehicles approaching from the right
Give way to vehicles approaching from the left
Act according to the mutual agreement of the drivers

questions.comment: When the trajectories of a vehicle intersect, and the order of passage is not specified by the Rules (for example, at parking areas, at gas stations, etc.), it is necessary to give way to a vehicle approaching from the right. (Clause 8.9 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: In what cases, on roads whose roadways are divided by marking lines, are drivers required to drive strictly along the lanes?

answers.text: Only if lanes are marked with solid lines

questions.comment: If there are markings, traffic is carried out strictly along the designated lanes in all cases. (Clause 9.7 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Location of vehicles on the roadway

questions.question: The driver of the vehicle being overtaken:

answers.text: Has the right to act at his own discretion

questions.comment: The driver of an overtaken vehicle is prohibited from preventing overtaking by increasing the speed or other actions. (Clause 11.3 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Are you allowed to stop a truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons at the specified place?

answers.text: Permitted for loading or unloading only

questions.comment: In populated areas on roads with one lane in each direction, without tram tracks in the middle, stopping and parking is allowed not only on the right side, but also on the left in the direction of travel. But in stopping places for route vehicles, marked with yellow zigzag markings 1.17.1, stopping is permitted only for boarding and disembarking passengers. (Clause 12.1 of the Traffic Regulations, “Horizontal markings”)

questions.question: You intend to turn right. What are your actions?

answers.text: Wait for another signal from the traffic controller
Give way to a car making a U-turn

questions.comment: From the side of the traffic controller's outstretched right hand, trackless vehicles are only allowed to move to the right. In this case, the turning car, guided by the “right-hand rule,” gives way to you. (Clause 6.10 of the traffic rules)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: In what case should you miss the tram?

answers.text: When turning left, changing lanes onto tram tracks in the same direction
In both of the above cases

questions.comment: You and the tram are on the same road under equal conditions. In this case, the tram always has an advantage over trackless vehicles. You must give way to the tram in both of these cases. (Clause 13.11 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: What should you do when turning left?
questions.comment: The intersection is unregulated and unequal. Vehicles located on the main road have priority, which are guided by the “right-hand rule” among themselves. Afterwards, vehicles on the secondary road pass the intersection. The truck passes first, you give way to it. The last one to pass will be a passenger car. (Clause 13.3, 13.9, 13.12 of traffic rules)

questions.question: You are required to give way to a truck:

answers.text: In both of the above cases

questions.comment: You are leaving a residential area, as indicated by sign 5.22 “End of a residential area.” Give way to other road users, in this situation - to a truck in both of the above cases. (“Road signs”, clause 17.3 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: The driving time for trucks with a permissible maximum weight exceeding 3.5 tons and buses during a calendar week should not exceed:
questions.comment: According to clause 26.2 of the traffic rules, the time spent driving a vehicle should not exceed 56 hours during a calendar week.

questions.question: Administrative liability is established for violation of traffic rules or vehicle operating rules, resulting in the following:

answers.text: Minor harm to human health or minor material damage
Mild or moderate harm to human health
Light or moderate harm to human health or material damage

questions.comment: In accordance with Art. 12.24 of the Code of Administrative Offenses, administrative liability is established for violations of traffic rules or vehicle operating rules that resulted in minor or moderate harm to human health. “Code of the Russian Federation on Administrative Offenses.”

questions.question: How to properly perform emergency braking on a slippery road if the car is not equipped with an anti-lock braking system?

answers.text: Press the brake pedal all the way and hold it until it comes to a complete stop.
Press the brake pedal while applying the parking brake
Brake by intermittently pressing the brake pedal, avoiding wheel locking.

questions.comment: Emergency, non-service, braking on a slippery surface should be done in combination, i.e., “engine braking” (without disengaging the clutch until the speed drops significantly) and intermittently pressing the brake pedal, avoiding complete blocking of the wheels, which will result in “skidding” and an increase in braking distance. The main mistake in this case is holding the pedal for a long time, that is, the inability to brake pulsatingly (intermittently).

questions.question: How does a driver perceive the speed of his car when driving for a long time on a flat road at high speed?

answers.text: Seems smaller than it really is
Perception of speed does not change
Seems bigger than it really is

questions.comment: The driver determines the speed of movement by the speed of movement of objects falling into his field of vision. During long monotonous movement, the speed seems less than in reality. To control your speed in such situations, use the speedometer more often than usual.

questions.question: Subcategory “D1” includes vehicles intended for the transport of passengers and having:

answers.text: More than 8 seats including driver's seat
More than 8 but not more than 16 seats, including the driver's seat
More than 8 but not more than 16 seats in addition to the driver's seat

questions.comment: According to Art. 25 clause 1 of the Federal Law “On Road Safety” category “D1” includes vehicles intended for the transport of passengers and having more than 8, but not more than 16 seats, in addition to the driver’s seat.

questions.question: Which of the following signs are installed immediately before a railway crossing?
questions.comment: Of those marked, only sign “В” - 1.3.2 “Multi-track railway” - is installed immediately before the railway crossing. It should be taken into account that in the absence of barriers on the railway. When crossing, signs 1.3.1 and 1.3.2 determine the size of the crossing. Combinations of signs “А” and “Б” are installed outside populated areas at a distance of 150-300 m (“Road signs”)

questions.question: You are allowed to make a U-turn:

answers.text: Along any trajectory of the specified

questions.comment: Traffic at the intersection marked with sign 4.3 “Roundabout” is organized in a circle in the direction of the arrows. Trajectory “А” passes in the opposite direction, which is unacceptable. To make a U-turn, you should go to the intersection and take a “lap of honor.” A U-turn can only be made along trajectory “Б”. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Can you park your car behind the overpass?

answers.text: No closer than 5 m from the overpass support

questions.comment: In the indicated location, parking is prohibited with sign 3.28 “Parking prohibited,” which extends to the nearest intersection. The overpass cannot terminate the validity of this sign. (“Road Signs”)

questions.question: Are you allowed to change lanes with reversible traffic in this situation?

answers.text: Permitted only for left turns or U-turns

questions.comment: The green arrow of a reversible traffic light allows movement in the reversible lane. You can cross the double broken line marking 1.9 to follow it, i.e. in the same direction. (Clause 6.7 of the Traffic Regulations, “Horizontal markings”)

questions.question: You are allowed to move:

answers.text: In any of the directions indicated

questions.comment: The traffic controller’s actions apply to the intersection of roadways at which he is located. We will assume that it is at the first intersection. From the arm's length side, trackless vehicles are only allowed to move to the right. You can continue moving along trajectory “А”. (Clause 6.10 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: What turn signals are you required to turn on when making a U-turn along such a trajectory?

answers.text: First turn right, and when moving from the sidewalk - turn left

questions.comment: If, when turning outside an intersection, the width of the roadway is not sufficient to perform the maneuver from the extreme position (in accordance with paragraph 8.5), it is allowed to be performed from the right edge of the roadway. A U-turn along this trajectory is made on a narrow road. During its execution, it is necessary to exercise great caution and do not perform it at high speed, since the driver driving behind may, when the right turn signal is turned on at the initial moment, think that you are making a stop. After turning on the left indicator, make sure once again that there is no obstacle, since during a turn you must give way to both passing and oncoming vehicles. (Clause 8.1, 8.5, 8.8 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: A situation in which the driver of a vehicle moving in the right lane is required to give way when changing lanes is shown:
questions.comment: When changing lanes at the same time, drivers are guided by the “right-hand rule.” This is the situation in the right picture. A car moving in the right lane has priority. In the left picture there is a single rebuild. The driver of a small bus, changing lanes, gives way to vehicles moving in the same direction without changing the direction of movement. In such a situation, the “owner of the lane”, the driver of a passenger car, has an advantage. The correct answer is in the left figure. (Clause 8.4 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Is the driver of a small bus allowed to drive in reverse to pick up a passenger?

answers.text: Permitted if it does not interfere with route vehicles

questions.comment: Reversing in areas where route vehicles stop is prohibited. (Clause 8.11, 8.12 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: In this situation, in order to continue driving in a forward direction, you have the right:

answers.text: Pass the truck on the right
Continue driving only after the truck makes a left turn
Perform any of the following actions

questions.comment: In this situation, you have the right to choose: either pass the truck on the right; or wait until the lane you are on is cleared in order to continue moving without unnecessary lane changes. (Traffic rules: 1.2 terms “Changing lanes”, Advancing”, 8.4)

questions.question: Is it prohibited to overtake on bridges, overpasses, overpasses and under them?

answers.text: Prohibited only under bridges, overpasses and overpasses
Prohibited only if there is a continuous marking line

questions.comment: Overtaking is prohibited - on bridges, overpasses, overpasses and under them. (Clause 11.4 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Can you stop in the tunnel to pick up a passenger?
questions.comment: Definitely not. Since stopping in tunnels, under overpasses, bridges, overpasses is prohibited. (Clause 12.4 of traffic rules)

questions.question: What should you do when turning right?

answers.text: Stop before the stop line and let pedestrians pass and turn right
When you arrive at an intersection, stop in front of the pedestrian crossing to let pedestrians pass.
Continue driving without stopping at the intersection

questions.comment: When turning right or left at any intersection (controlled, unregulated), the driver is obliged to give way to pedestrians crossing the roadway onto which he is turning. (Clause 6.2, 13.1 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: When moving in which direction will you have an advantage?
questions.comment: The intersection is equal. Drivers are guided by the “right hand rule”. You have no interference on the right, in any of the directions listed. Pass the intersection first. (Clause 13.11 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: You intend to continue straight ahead. What are your actions?
questions.comment: The intersection is unequal. You and the tram are on the main road. The “right hand rule” does not work in this case. Under equal conditions, a tram has an advantage over trackless vehicles. Give way to the tram. (Clause 13.11 of the Traffic Regulations, “Road signs”)

questions.question: On which sections of the highway is it prohibited to drive in reverse?

answers.text: Only at entry or exit points
Only in places where route vehicles stop

questions.comment: Reversing on the highway is prohibited along the entire length of the road. (Clause 16.1 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: During daylight hours, you must turn on low beam headlights or daytime running lights:

answers.text: Only when driving outside the populated area
Only when driving in a populated area
In both of the above cases

questions.comment: When driving during daylight hours, in all cases, the vehicle must turn on low beam headlights or daytime running lights. (Clause 19.5 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Use of external lighting fixtures and audible signals

questions.question: What malfunction prevents the vehicle from driving during rain or snow?

answers.text: Windshield wipers do not work as intended
Driver's side windshield wiper does not work

questions.comment: It is prohibited to drive with the windshield wiper inoperative on the driver's side during rain or snowfall. (Clause 2.3.1 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Malfunctions and conditions for admitting vehicles to operation

questions.question: With increasing speed when turning, the magnitude of the centrifugal force is:

answers.text: Increases with the square of the speed

questions.comment: Centrifugal force depends on the mass of the car, the turning radius and is proportional to the square of the speed. The driver cannot influence the weight of a moving vehicle. It can increase the turning radius somewhat, but the speed, which is the most effective value, for this force completely depends on the driver. Therefore, before entering a turn, it is recommended to reduce speed. ("Driving Techniques")

questions.question: How is first aid provided for broken limbs if there are no transport tires and available means for their manufacture?

answers.text: The upper limb, extended along the body, is bandaged to the body. The lower limbs are bandaged to each other, with soft fabric placed between them.
The upper limb, bent at the elbow, is suspended on a scarf and bandaged to the body. The lower limbs are bandaged to each other, making sure to place soft fabric between them.
The upper limb, bent at the elbow, is suspended on a scarf and bandaged to the body. The lower limbs are pressed tightly against each other and bandaged.

questions.comment: In such a situation, the upper limb, bent at the elbow, is suspended on a scarf and bandaged to the body. The lower limbs are bandaged to each other, making sure to place soft fabric between them. The peculiarity of the action is to lay soft cloth between the limbs.

questions.question: How many roadways does this intersection have?
questions.comment: This intersection has two intersections of roadways, which are formed by a dividing strip. (Clause 1.2 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: These signs warn of the approach:

answers.text: To the place of work on the road
Towards a railway crossing with a barrier
To a railway crossing without a barrier

questions.comment: Sign 1.1 “Railway crossing with a barrier” and sign 1.4.1 “Approaching a railway crossing” are located on the same post, since outside the populated area they are located at a distance of 150 - 300 m from the dangerous area. Outside the populated area, sign 1.1 must be repeated. These signs warn of approaching a railway crossing with barriers. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Are you allowed to overtake if you are driving a bus?

answers.text: Permitted if the speed of the truck being overtaken is less than 30 km/h

questions.comment: Sign 3.22 “Overtaking by trucks is prohibited” applies only to trucks with r.m.m. more than 3.5 tons. This sign does not apply to buses. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: You can continue driving in the leftmost lane:
questions.comment: Signs indicating the direction of movement along lanes (lanes) that permit a left turn from the leftmost lane also permit a U-turn. When moving in the leftmost lane, according to sign 5.15.2 “Lane directions”, you can turn left or turn around to continue moving in the opposite direction. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Are you allowed to stop at this place?

answers.text: Allowed only with entry onto the sidewalk
Permitted if it does not interfere with route vehicles

questions.comment: The intermittent yellow line 1.10 indicates places where parking is prohibited. There is nothing contradicting the stop.(“Horizontal markings”)

questions.question: The driver of the car has an advantage over other road users:

answers.text: Only with blue or white-lunar flashing light turned on
Only with orange or yellow flashing light turned on
Only with a blue flashing light (blue and red) and a special sound signal turned on

questions.comment: To gain an advantage, an “operational” vehicle must use a combination of a blue or blue and red flashing light and a special sound signal. (Clause 3.1 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: You intend to stop just beyond the intersection. At what point should the right turn indicators be turned on?

answers.text: Before entering an intersection, to warn other drivers about stopping in advance
The location where the turn signals are turned on does not matter, since right turns are prohibited

questions.comment: Here the answer should be supplemented with clarification. Each driver is guided in his actions only by those signs that are located on his road. In the situation depicted, the driver of the car knows about your advantage. You judge this by his actions. You are convinced that he is giving way. Turning on the turn signal before the intersection will be clearly perceived by him: that you intend to make a right turn. Turning on immediately after entering an intersection may also be interpreted incorrectly. For example, that you are somewhat delayed in making a decision on the direction of further movement, but will still make a right turn. Therefore, turn on the turn signal at the intersection, but not in the initial phase of entering the intersection. Then a mandatory condition will be met - the signal will not mislead other road users. (Clause 8.2 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: When leaving the road into the adjacent territory on the right, you:

answers.text: Take advantage of other road users
Must give way only to pedestrians
Must give way only to cyclists
Must give way to pedestrians and cyclists

questions.comment: When leaving the road into the adjacent territory, give way to cyclists and pedestrians whose path you are crossing. (Clause 8.3 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Are you allowed to make a U-turn when driving on an incline?

answers.text: Allowed only when road visibility is 100 meters or more

questions.comment: A broken road limits visibility. A U-turn is prohibited in places where visibility of the road in at least one direction is less than 100 m. (Clause 8.11 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: What is the maximum speed allowed to continue driving when towing a disabled motor vehicle?
questions.comment: When towing, the speed should not exceed 50 km/h, which is the maximum.(Clause 10.4 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: Can you start overtaking?

answers.text: Yes, if overtaking is completed before the intersection

questions.comment: Table 8.1.1 “Distance to object” under sign 2.4 “Give way” indicates the distance from the sign to the intersection of unequal roads on which overtaking is permitted in the direction of the main road. You are on a secondary road, so overtaking that has begun must be completed before the intersection. (“Road signs”, clause 11.4 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Is the driver of a truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons allowed to stop at the specified place?

answers.text: Allowed for loading or unloading only

questions.comment: On one-way roads on the left side of the road in the direction of travel, trucks are allowed to stop only in connection with loading or unloading. The rules of stopping at a pedestrian crossing are not violated, since it is made behind it. (Clause 12.1, 12.4 of traffic rules)

questions.question: What should you do when turning left?

answers.text: Give way only to a car with a flashing light and a special sound signal on

questions.comment: The intersection is controlled. Priority signs don't work. The “operative” with special signals deviates from the requirements of traffic light signals. Other drivers are obliged to ensure his unhindered passage. When turning left, you are required to give way to a passenger car moving straight from the opposite direction. (Clause 3.1, 3.2, 13.3, 13.4 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: When driving in which direction are you required to give way to a tram?
questions.comment: The intersection is equal. You and the tram are in equal conditions. In this case, the tram always has an advantage over trackless vehicles. (Clause 13.11 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: You intend to turn right. Can you start turning?

answers.text: You can after the truck starts turning left.

questions.comment: The intersection is unequal. Sign 2.4 obliges you to give way to vehicles moving along the road you are crossing. Only after you are sure that the truck is actually turning left and your movement cannot interfere with it, enter the intersection to make a right turn. (Clause 1.2, 13.9 Traffic Regulations, “Road Signs”)

questions.question: Having approached the tram of the same direction, which stopped at the landing site, which is located in the middle of the road, the driver must:

answers.text: Give way to pedestrians walking to or from the tram
Stop and continue driving only after the tram doors are closed
Stop and continue moving only after the tram starts moving

questions.comment: If there is a landing area, give way to pedestrians walking to or from the tram. In the absence of pedestrians crossing the roadway from the side of the doors, taking the necessary precautions, i.e. the possibility of stopping you at any time when a “jumping pedestrian” appears, you can continue driving without waiting for the doors to close and the route vehicle to start moving. (Clause 14.6 of the Traffic Regulations. “Commentary to the Traffic Regulations of the Russian Federation”, publishing house “Za Rulem”)
topic: Pedestrian crossings and stops of fixed-route vehicles

questions.question: What vehicle is used for organized transportation of a group of children?

answers.text: A bus other than a fixed-route vehicle that is equipped with seat belts
A truck with a box body designed to transport people

questions.comment: For organized transportation of a group of children, only a bus that is not a route vehicle is used. This bus transports children in accordance with special Rules. These buses must be equipped with identification signs “Transportation of Children”. (Clause 1.2, the term “Organized transportation of a group of children”, paragraph 22.6 of the traffic rules, paragraph 8 of the “Basic provisions for admission”)

questions.question: The owner of a vehicle is obliged to compensate for damage caused by this vehicle unless he proves that the damage occurred:

answers.text: Exclusively due to the intent of the victim
Due to force majeure or the intent of the victim

questions.comment: According to Article 1079 of the Civil Code of the Russian Federation, they can be considered both a consequence of force majeure and a consequence of the victim’s intent. “Civil Code of the Russian Federation.”

questions.question: When driving at night during a heavy snowstorm, the best visibility of the road is ensured by turning on:

answers.text: Fog lights together with low beam headlights
Fog lights together with high beam headlights

questions.comment: Blizzards and fog create very dangerous driving conditions. When driving in such conditions, use low beam headlights. If there are fog lights, use them together. High beams are not used in snowstorms because they highlight the snow, which forms a “blinding wall of light” that reduces visibility of the road.

questions.question: In what cases should the victim be removed from the car?

answers.text: If there is a high probability of a vehicle rollover, fire, explosion, or if the victim loses consciousness

In case of a high probability of a car rollover, fire, explosion, hypothermia of the victim, in the absence of consciousness and breathing, as well as the impossibility of providing first aid directly inside the car
If there is a high risk of vehicle rollover, fire, explosion, or severe bleeding or traumatic brain injury

questions.comment: Only if there is a high probability of a car overturning, a fire, an explosion, hypothermia of the victim, in the absence of consciousness and breathing, as well as the impossibility of providing first aid directly in the car, the victim must be removed from the car.

questions.question: In what form is the submission for verification of an insurance policy of compulsory civil liability insurance provided?

answers.text: In the form of an electronic document or its copy on paper
In any of the above types

questions.comment: According to the new paragraph of Rules 2.1.1(1) of the Traffic Regulations, the specified insurance policy can be provided by the driver on paper, and if such an agreement is concluded in the manner established by clause 72 of article and clause 15 of the Federal Insurance Law, in the form of an electronic document or a copy thereof on paper.

questions.question: This sign warns of approaching a tunnel in which:

answers.text: It will be difficult to pass oncoming vehicles
The traffic order is regulated by traffic lights

questions.comment: Sign 1.31 “Tunnel” warns of approaching a tunnel in which there is no artificial lighting, or a tunnel whose visibility of the entrance portal is limited. In tunnels, a moving vehicle must have high or low beam headlights on, regardless of whether the tunnel is illuminated. (“Road signs”, clause 19.1 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: You have the right to continue driving at the intersection:

answers.text: In all indicated directions except Г

questions.comment: You can continue driving without violating the Rules in directions “А” and “В”. Traffic in direction “Г” is prohibited by sign 3.18.1 “Right turn prohibited.” Direction “Б” passes along the roadway of oncoming traffic. Such movement is strictly prohibited. (Clause 1.4 of the Traffic Regulations, “Road Signs”)

questions.question: Which of the following signs allow you to turn left?
questions.comment: All signs allow you to turn left. Sign “А” - 3.19 “No U-turn” - allows you to turn left. Signs “Б” and “В” also do not prohibit making a maneuver - turning left. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: If you have this marking on the traffic lane, you are allowed to:

answers.text: Turn left and make a U-turn

questions.comment: Horizontal marking 1.18 allows left turns and U-turns from this lane. (“Horizontal markings”)

questions.question: You can move:
questions.comment: The right hand of the adjuster is extended forward. With this gesture of the adjuster from the left side, trackless vehicles are allowed to move in all directions - straight, right, left and U-turn.(Clause 6.10 of the Traffic Rules)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: What external lighting devices must be turned on on a vehicle that has the “Transportation of Children” markings when boarding and disembarking children?

answers.text: Low beam headlights or fog lights

questions.comment: The hazard warning lights must be turned on when children are boarding or disembarking from a vehicle that has the “Transportation of Children” markings. (Clause 7.1 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Use of hazard warning lights and warning triangles

questions.question: The driver of a small bus changing lane to the right lane in this situation:

answers.text: Must not interfere with a car moving in the right lane
Has an advantage because it completes overtaking
Has an advantage because the bus has right turn indicators

questions.comment: When changing lanes alone, the driver must give way to the “owner of the lane” - vehicles moving in the same direction without changing direction. (Clause 8.4 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Are you allowed to make a U-turn at the designated location?

answers.text: Permitted if road visibility is at least 100 m

questions.comment: There's a turn ahead. You can make a U-turn if the visibility of the road is at least 100 m. (Clause 8.11 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: At what maximum speed do you have the right to continue driving a truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons?
questions.comment: On the motorway, trucks with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons can travel at a maximum speed of 90 km/h. (Clause 10.3 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: On what trajectory can a small-bus driver overtake?
questions.comment: Overtaking is prohibited at equivalent intersections. Therefore, the driver of a small vehicle can only overtake along trajectory “А”. (Clause 11.4 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Are you allowed to stop at the indicated place?

answers.text: Permitted only for loading or unloading a vehicle

questions.comment: The left lane on the road, marked with sign 5.11.2 “Road with a lane for cyclists”, according to markings 1.23.3, is reserved for the movement of cyclists, mopeds and people using personal mobility devices towards the general flow of vehicles. Other vehicles are prohibited from driving along this lane and stopping on it. (Clauses 9.9, 12.4 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: You intend to drive straight through the intersection. What are your actions?

answers.text: You will pass first, guided by the traffic light signal.
You will pass first, following the “Main Road” sign.

questions.comment: The intersection is regulated by a traffic light. Priority signs don't work. You and the tram are in equal conditions. In such situations, a tram always has an advantage over trackless vehicles, so you give way to the tram. (Clause 13.6 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: What should you do when turning left?
questions.comment: The intersection is equal. Drivers of trackless vehicles are guided by the “right-hand rule” among themselves, i.e. whoever has an obstacle on the right gives way. You have an obstacle on the right, a passenger car passes first. (Clause 13.11 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Who should you give way to when driving straight?
questions.comment: The intersection is unequal. The main road changes direction. Initially, vehicles on the main road pass through the intersection. They have an advantage. Between themselves they are guided by the “right hand rule”. You have an obstacle on the right, you are second only to a passenger car. (Clause 13.9, 13.10, 13.11 Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Did the driver violate the Rules during a forced stop on the highway?

answers.text: Violated by not displaying a warning triangle

questions.comment: The driver made a forced stop on the highway. To carry out repair work, he took the vehicle to a specially designated lane. According to paragraphs 16.2, 7.1, 7.2 of the traffic rules in the situation depicted, you should turn on the hazard warning lights and place a warning triangle at a distance of at least 30 m, because The action takes place outside the populated area.
topic: Use of hazard warning lights and warning triangles

questions.question: Is towing permitted in icy conditions if the towed vehicle has working brakes and steering?

answers.text: Allowed only with rigid coupling or partial loading method

questions.comment: Towing in icy conditions using a flexible hitch is prohibited under any circumstances. Towing using the method of partial loading or using a rigid coupling is not prohibited. (Clause 20.4 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Is it allowed to install tires with anti-skid studs on a vehicle together with tires without anti-skid studs?
questions.comment: It is prohibited to install studded or studless tires on a vehicle. (“List of faults” clause 5.2)
topic: Malfunctions and conditions for admitting vehicles to operation

questions.question: When parking a truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons, to prevent its spontaneous movement on an ascent or descent, you should:

answers.text: Carry out both of the above actions

questions.comment: When parking a truck with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons, to prevent its spontaneous movement on an ascent or descent, use the parking brake and, in addition, install wheel chocks, of which there must be at least two. (“List of faults,” paragraph 7.7)

questions.question: What is meant by stopping route?

answers.text: The distance traveled by the vehicle from the moment the driver detects the danger until it comes to a complete stop
The distance traveled by the vehicle from the moment you press the brake pedal until it comes to a complete stop
The distance traveled by the vehicle from the moment the brake drive begins to operate until it comes to a complete stop

questions.comment: Stopping distance is the distance traveled by a vehicle from the moment the driver detects a danger until it comes to a complete stop. The stopping distance includes: the distance during the driver's reaction time plus the distance during the activation of the brake system, plus slowing down the vehicle to zero speed. (“Driving technology”)

questions.question: At the request of which persons it is necessary to transfer for verification a driver's license for the right to drive a vehicle of the corresponding category or subcategory and submit for verification an insurance policy of compulsory civil liability insurance on paper or in the form of an electronic document or a copy thereof on paper?

answers.text: Employee of the Military Automobile Inspectorate

questions.comment: Clause 2.1.1 of the traffic rules obliges the driver to perform the listed actions only at the request of a police officer.

questions.question: You are allowed to continue driving the route vehicle:
questions.comment: Route vehicles retreat from the effect of sign 4.1.1 “Move straight ahead”. Therefore, you, the driver of such a vehicle, are allowed to move at the intersection in any direction in accordance with the established route. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Which of the following signs permit a U-turn?
questions.comment: Mandatory signs, which include the sign А - 4.1.3 "Movement to the left", allowing a turn to the left, also allow a U-turn. Sign В - 5.7.2 "Exit to a one-way road" prohibits turning to the right, but does not prohibit turning. Most often, both drivers and traffic police officers either forget or do not know that the sign Б - 3.18.2 "Left turn is prohibited" does not prohibit turning. Therefore, all three of these signs allow you to make a maneuver - a U-turn.(“Traffic Signs”)

questions.question: It is prohibited to park in the manner indicated on the sign:

answers.text: Only trucks with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 t

questions.comment: Plate 8.6.3 “Method of parking a vehicle” indicates how cars and motorcycles should be located on the edge of the sidewalk in the place indicated by sign 6.4 “Parking (parking space).” (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Markings in the form of the letter “А” indicate:

answers.text: Stopping and parking place for any buses

questions.comment: Horizontal marking 1.23.1 (in the form of the letter “А”) designates a special lane for route vehicles, which include buses and trolleybuses moving along established routes with designated stops. Minibus taxis do not fall into this category.

questions.question: Are you allowed to move?

answers.text: Allowed straight and to the right

questions.comment: Let us remember the aphorism “back is a wall”. You are prohibited from moving from the back. (Clause 6.10 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: What identification mark must be attached to the rear of a towed motor vehicle if the hazard warning lights are missing or faulty?
questions.comment: “А” is a warning triangle. (Clause 7.3 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Use of hazard warning lights and warning triangles

questions.question: At the intersection you intend to turn right. What should you do?

answers.text: Change into the right lane, then make a turn
Continue in the left lane until the intersection, then turn

questions.comment: The effect of sign 5.15.1 “Directions of traffic along lanes” installed in front of the intersection applies to the entire intersection, unless other signs 5.15.1 and 5.15.2 installed on it give other instructions. Turning right is allowed from both lanes, so both options are acceptable. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Who must give way when making a U-turn at the same time?

answers.text: In this situation, drivers should act by mutual agreement

questions.comment: In cases of determining the order of passage of vehicles not specified in the Rules, drivers are guided by the “right hand rule”, i.e. whoever has an obstacle on the right concedes. The bus driver has an obstacle on the right and gives way. (Clause 8.9 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: What should a driver take into account when determining the number of lanes on the roadway in the absence of signs and markings?

answers.text: Only the width of the roadway
